verses.1:1: And it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, on the fifth day of the month, as I was in the midst of the captivity by the river Chebar, that the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.
verses.1:2: On the fifth day of the month, this was the fifth year of the captivity of King Jehoiakim,
verses.1:3: and the word of the Lord came to Ezekiel the son of Buzi, the priest, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar. And the hand of the Lord came upon me,
verses.1:4: and I looked, and behold, a sweeping wind was coming from the north, and a great cloud was in it, and brightness was all around it, and flashing fire; and in the midst of it was something like the appearance of electrum in the midst of the fire, and brightness was in it.
verses.1:5: And in the midst was something like the likeness of four living creatures; and this was their appearance: the likeness of a man was upon them.
verses.1:6: And each one had four faces, and each one had four wings.
verses.1:7: And their legs were straight, and their feet were winged, and sparks were like flashing bronze; and their wings were light,
verses.1:8: and a man's hand was beneath their wings on their four sides.
verses.1:9: And the faces of the four of them did not turn as they walked; each one went straight ahead before their faces.
verses.1:10: And the likeness of their faces was this: the face of a man, and the face of a lion on the right side for the four of them, and the face of a calf on the left side for the four of them, and the face of an eagle for the four of them.
verses.1:11: And the wings of the four of them were stretched out above: each had two joined to one another, and two covered over their bodies.
verses.1:12: And each one went straight ahead before its face; wherever the spirit was going, they went, and they did not turn.
verses.1:13: And in the midst of the living creatures was an appearance like burning coals of fire, like the sight of torches moving to and fro among the living creatures, and brightness of the fire; and out of the fire went forth lightning.
verses.1:15: And I looked, and behold, one wheel was upon the earth beside the living creatures, for the four of them.
verses.1:16: And the appearance of the wheels was like the appearance of Tarshish, and the four of them had one likeness; and their workmanship was as if a wheel were within a wheel.
verses.1:17: Toward their four sides they went; they did not turn as they went,
verses.1:18: nor did their rims, and they had height; and I looked at them, and their rims were full of eyes all around for the four of them.
verses.1:19: And when the living creatures went, the wheels went beside them; and when the living creatures lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.
verses.1:20: Wherever the cloud was, there the spirit was to go; the wheels went and were lifted up together with them, for a spirit of life was in the wheels.
verses.1:21: When those went, they went; and when those stood still, they stood still; and when those lifted up from the earth, they were lifted up together with them, because a spirit of life was in the wheels.
verses.1:22: And a likeness was over the heads of the living creatures, like a firmament, like the appearance of crystal, stretched out above over their wings.
verses.1:23: And beneath the firmament their wings were stretched out, flapping one toward another; each had two covering their bodies.
verses.1:24: And I heard the sound of their wings as they went, like the sound of much water; and when they stood still, their wings rested.
verses.1:25: And behold, there was a voice from above the firmament that was over their heads.
verses.1:26: Like the appearance of a sapphire stone was the likeness of a throne upon it; and upon the likeness of the throne was a likeness like the appearance of a man above.
verses.1:27: And I saw something like the sight of electrum from the appearance of the loins and upward, and from the appearance of the loins and downward I saw something like the appearance of fire, and its brightness was all around.
verses.1:28: Like the appearance of a bow when it is in the cloud in days of rain, so was the state of the brightness all around.
verses.2:1: This was the vision of the likeness of the glory of the Lord. And I looked, and I fell upon my face, and I heard the voice of One speaking, and He said to me, "Son of man, stand upon your feet, and I will speak to you."
verses.2:2: And the Spirit came upon me, and took me up, and lifted me up, and set me upon my feet; and I heard Him speaking to me,
verses.2:3: and He said to me, "Son of man, I send you forth to the house of Israel, those who provoke Me, who have provoked Me, they and their fathers, until this very day,
verses.2:4: and you shall say to them, 'Thus says the Lord,'
verses.2:5: whether indeed they hear or are dismayed—for it is a provoking house—yet they shall know that you are a prophet in the midst of them.
verses.2:6: And you, son of man, do not fear them, nor be dismayed before their face; for they will rage furiously and rise up against you all around, and you dwell in the midst of scorpions. Do not fear their words, and do not be dismayed before their face, for it is a provoking house.
verses.2:7: And you shall speak My words to them, whether indeed they hear or are dismayed, because it is a provoking house.
verses.2:8: And you, son of man, hear the One who speaks to you; do not become provoking like the provoking house. Open wide your mouth and eat what I give to you."
verses.2:9: And I looked, and behold, a hand was stretched out to me, and in it was a scroll of a book.
verses.2:10: And He unrolled it before me, and in it was writing on the front and on the back; and there were written lamentation, and song, and woe.
verses.3:1: And He said to me, "Son of man, eat up this scroll, and go and speak to the sons of Israel."
verses.3:2: And He opened wide my mouth, and He fed me the scroll.
verses.3:3: And He said to me, "Son of man, your mouth shall eat, and your belly shall be filled with this scroll that is given to you." And I ate it, and it became in my mouth like sweet honey.
verses.3:4: And He said to me, "Son of man, walk and go in to the house of Israel, and speak My words to them;
verses.3:5: for you are not sent forth to a people of deep speech—to the house of Israel—
verses.3:6: nor to many peoples of foreign voice or of foreign tongue, nor to those who are thick of tongue, whose words you will not understand; and if I had sent you forth to such as these, they would have listened to you.
verses.3:7: But the house of Israel will by no means be willing to listen to you, for they do not wish to listen to Me; because all the house of Israel are contentious and hard-hearted.
verses.3:8: And behold, I have made your face strong over against their faces, and I will strengthen your contention over against their contention,
verses.3:9: and it shall continually be mightier than rock. Do not be afraid of them, nor be dismayed before their face, for it is a provoking house."
verses.3:10: And He said to me, "Son of man, receive into your heart all the words that I have spoken with you, and hear with your ears;
verses.3:11: and walk, go in to the captivity, to the sons of your people; and you shall speak to them and say to them, 'Thus says the Lord,' whether indeed they hear or whether indeed they yield."
verses.3:12: And the Spirit took me up, and I heard behind me, and I heard the sound of a great earthquake: "Blessed is the glory of the Lord from His place."
verses.3:13: And I saw the sound of the wings of the living creatures flapping one against another, and the sound of the wheels beside them, and the sound of the earthquake.
verses.3:14: And the Spirit lifted me up and took me up, and I went in the impulse of my spirit; and the hand of the Lord was mighty upon me.
verses.3:15: And I went in to the captivity aloft, and went around among those who dwelt by the river Chebar, those who were there; and I sat there seven days, moving about in the midst of them.
verses.3:16: And it came to pass after the seven days that the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.3:17: "Son of man, I have appointed you a watchman to the house of Israel; and you shall hear a word from My mouth, and warn them sternly from Me.
verses.3:18: When I say to the lawless man, 'You shall surely be put to death,' and you do not warn him, nor speak to warn the lawless man to turn away from his ways so that he may live, that lawless man shall die in his unrighteousness, but his blood I will require from your hand.
verses.3:19: Yet if you warn the lawless man, and he does not turn away from his lawlessness and from the way, that lawless man shall die in his unrighteousness, but you shall deliver your soul.
verses.3:20: And when a righteous man turns away from his righteous deeds and commits a transgression, and I set the torment before his face, he shall die; because you did not warn him, he shall also die in his sins, for his righteous deeds shall by no means be remembered; and his blood I will require from your hand.
verses.3:21: But if you warn the righteous man not to sin, and he does not sin, the righteous man shall surely live, because you warned him; and you shall deliver your own soul."
verses.3:22: And the hand of the Lord came upon me, and He said to me, "Arise and go out into the plain, and there it shall be spoken to you."
verses.3:23: And I arose and went out into the plain, and behold, the glory of the Lord stood there, like the vision and like the glory that I had seen by the river Chebar; and I fell upon my face.
verses.3:24: And the Spirit came upon me and set me upon my feet, and He spoke to me and said to me, "Go in and shut yourself up in the midst of your house.
verses.3:25: And you, son of man, behold, bonds have been laid upon you, and they shall bind you with them, and you shall by no means go out from the midst of them.
verses.3:26: And I will bind your tongue fast, and you shall become mute, and you shall not be to them a man who reproves, for it is a provoking house.
verses.3:27: And when I speak to you, I will open your mouth, and you shall say to them, 'Thus says the Lord: Let him who hears, hear, and let him who disobeys, disobey,' for it is a provoking house."
verses.4:1: "And you, son of man, take for yourself a brick and set it before your face, and you shall depict upon it a city, even Jerusalem,
verses.4:2: and you shall lay siege against it, and build bulwarks against it, and cast up a palisade against it, and set camps against it, and station the siege engines all around.
verses.4:3: And you, take for yourself an iron pan, and you shall place it as an iron wall between you and the city; and you shall set your face steadily against it, and it shall be under siege, and you shall besiege it. This is a sign to the sons of Israel.
verses.4:4: And you shall lie upon your left side, and you shall lay the iniquities of the house of Israel upon it according to the number of the days, one hundred and fifty, that you shall lie upon it, and you shall bear their iniquities.
verses.4:5: And I have appointed to you their two iniquities for a number of days, one hundred and ninety days, and you shall bear the iniquities of the house of Israel.
verses.4:6: And you shall complete these, and you shall lie upon your right side, and you shall bear the iniquities of the house of Judah forty days; a day for a year I have appointed to you.
verses.4:7: And toward the siege of Jerusalem you shall set your face, and you shall make your arm firm, and you shall prophesy against it.
verses.4:8: And behold, I have placed bonds upon you, and you shall not turn from your one side to your other side until the days of your siege are fulfilled.
verses.4:9: And you, take for yourself wheat and barley and beans and lentils and millet and spelt, and put them into one earthen vessel, and make them into loaves of bread for yourself; and according to the number of the days that you sleep upon your side, one hundred and ninety days, you shall eat them.
verses.4:10: And your food you shall eat by weight, twenty shekels a day; from time to time you shall eat them.
verses.4:11: And water by measure you shall drink; a sixth part of a hin from time to time you shall drink.
verses.4:12: And as a barley cake baked in ashes you shall eat them; in cakes of human dung you shall bake them before their eyes,
verses.4:13: and you shall say, 'Thus says the Lord God of Israel: So shall the sons of Israel eat unclean things among the nations.'"
verses.4:14: And I said, "By no means, O Lord God of Israel! Indeed, my soul has not been defiled in uncleanness, and what is torn by wild beasts or what died of itself I have not eaten from my birth until now, nor has any stale meat entered into my mouth."
verses.4:15: And He said to me, "Behold, I have given you cattle dung instead of human dung, and you shall prepare your loaves of bread upon it."
verses.4:16: And He said to me, "Son of man, behold, I am breaking the staff of bread in Jerusalem; and they shall eat bread by weight and in want, and water by measure and in desolation they shall drink,
verses.4:17: so that they may be in want of bread and water; and a man and his brother shall be brought to ruin, and they shall melt away in their iniquities."
verses.5:1: "And you, son of man, take for yourself a sword sharper than a barber's razor; you shall acquire it for yourself, and you shall bring it upon your head and upon your beard. And you shall take a balance of weights and divide them:
verses.5:2: a fourth part you shall kindle in fire in the midst of the city at the fulfillment of the days of the siege, and you shall take a fourth part and burn it up in the midst of it, and a fourth part you shall cut down with a sword all around it, and a fourth part you shall scatter to the wind, and I will unsheathe a sword after them.
verses.5:3: And you shall take from there a few in number and wrap them up in the fold of your garment.
verses.5:4: And from these again you shall take some and cast them into the midst of the fire, and burn them up in the fire; from it a fire shall go forth. And you shall say to all the house of Israel,
verses.5:5: 'Thus says the Lord: This is Jerusalem; in the midst of the nations I have set her, and the countries around her.
verses.5:6: And you shall declare My ordinances to the lawless one from among the nations, and My statutes from the countries that are around her, because they have rejected My ordinances and have not walked in My statutes.
verses.5:7: Therefore thus says the Lord: Because your occasion is from the nations that are around you, and you have not walked in My statutes, and you have not kept My ordinances, nor have you even acted according to the ordinances of the nations that are around you—
verses.5:8: therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I am against you, and I will execute judgment in your midst in the sight of the nations,
verses.5:9: and I will do in you things which I have not done, and the like of which I will never do again, according to all your abominations.
verses.5:10: Therefore fathers shall eat children in your midst, and children shall eat fathers; and I will execute judgments in you, and I will scatter all your remnant to every wind.
verses.5:11: Therefore, as I live, says the Lord, surely, because you have defiled My holy things with all your abominations, I also will cast you off; My eye shall not spare, nor will I have mercy.
verses.5:12: A fourth part of you shall be consumed by death, and a fourth part of you shall be brought to an end by famine in your midst, and a fourth part of you I will scatter to every wind, and a fourth part of you shall fall by the sword all around you, and I will unsheathe a sword after them.
verses.5:13: And My fury and My wrath shall be fulfilled upon them, and you shall know that I, the Lord, have spoken in My zeal, when I have fulfilled My wrath upon them.
verses.5:14: And I will make you a desolation, and your daughters all around you, in the sight of everyone who passes by;
verses.5:15: and you shall be an object of groaning and wretchedness among the nations that are around you, when I execute judgments in you in the vengeance of My fury. I, the Lord, have spoken,
verses.5:16: even when I send forth My arrows of famine upon them, and they shall be for utter exhaustion, and I will break your staff of bread.
verses.5:17: And I will send forth against you famine and evil wild beasts, and I will punish you; and death and blood shall pass through upon you, and I will bring a sword upon you all around. I, the Lord, have spoken.'"
verses.6:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.6:2: "Son of man, set your face steadfastly toward the mountains of Israel and prophesy against them,
verses.6:3: and you shall say, 'O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord! Thus says the Lord to the mountains and to the hills, and to the ravines and to the valleys: Behold, I am bringing a sword upon you, and your high places shall be utterly destroyed,
verses.6:4: and your altars and your sacred precincts shall be shattered, and I will cast down your slain before your idols,
verses.6:5: and I will scatter your bones all around your altars.
verses.6:6: In all your dwelling place the cities shall be laid waste and the high places shall be made desolate, so that your altars may be utterly destroyed, and your idols shall be shattered, and your sacred precincts may be swept away,
verses.6:7: and the slain shall fall in your midst, and you shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.6:8: When there come to be among the nations some of you who escape from the sword, and in your scattering throughout the countries,
verses.6:9: then those of you who escape shall remember Me among the nations where they were carried captive. I have sworn against their heart that plays the harlot away from Me, and against their eyes that play the harlot after their practices, and they shall beat their faces for all their abominations;
verses.6:10: and they shall know that I, the Lord, have spoken.'"
verses.6:11: Thus says the Lord: "Clap with your hand and stamp with your foot, and say, 'Aha! Aha!' over all the abominations of the house of Israel; by the sword and by death and by famine they shall fall.
verses.6:12: He who is near shall fall by the sword, and he who is far off shall perish by death, and he who is besieged shall come to an end by famine; and I will fulfill My wrath upon them.
verses.6:13: And you shall know that I am the Lord, when your slain lie in the midst of your idols, all around your altars, upon every high hill and beneath every shady tree, where they offered a pleasing aroma to all their idols.
verses.6:14: And I will stretch out My hand against them, and I will make the land a desolation and a ruin, from the wilderness of Deblatha throughout all the habitation; and you shall know that I am the Lord."
verses.7:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.7:2: "And you, son of man, say, 'Thus says the Lord to the land of Israel: An end has come, the end has come upon the four wings of the land.
verses.7:4: upon you who dwell in the land; the time has come, the day has drawn near—not with tumults, nor with pangs.
verses.7:5: Now shortly I will pour out My wrath upon you, and I will accomplish My fury in you, and I will judge you in your ways, and I will lay upon you all your abominations;
verses.7:6: My eye shall not spare, nor will I have mercy; for I will lay your ways upon you, and your abominations shall be in the midst of you, and you shall know that I am the Lord who strikes.
verses.7:7: Now the end is upon you, and I Myself will send against you and execute vengeance in your ways, and I will lay upon you all your abominations;
verses.7:8: My eye shall not spare, nor will I have mercy; for I will lay your way upon you, and your abominations shall be in the midst of you, and you shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.7:9: For thus says the Lord: Behold, the end has come,
verses.7:10: behold, the day of the Lord! Even though the rod has blossomed, arrogance has risen up.
verses.7:11: And it shall crush the support of the lawless, and not with tumult, nor with haste.
verses.7:12: The time has come; behold, the day! Do not let the one who buys rejoice, and do not let the one who sells mourn;
verses.7:13: for the one who buys shall no longer return to the one who sells, and a man shall not hold fast in the eye of his life.
verses.7:14: Sound the trumpet and judge all things!
verses.7:15: War with the sword is outside, and famine and death are within; he who is in the plain shall die by the sword, and famine and death shall consume those in the city.
verses.7:16: And the survivors among them shall escape and shall be upon the mountains; I will slay them all, each one in his iniquities.
verses.7:17: All hands shall grow faint, and all thighs shall be defiled with moisture,
verses.7:18: and they shall gird themselves with sackcloth, and terror shall cover them; and shame shall be upon every face among them, and baldness upon every head.
verses.7:19: Their silver shall be cast into the streets, and their gold shall be despised; their souls shall not be satisfied, and their bellies shall not be filled, for it has become the torment of their iniquities.
verses.7:20: Choice things of adornment they turned into pride, and they made images of their abominations out of them; because of this I have given them to them for uncleanness.
verses.7:21: And I will deliver them into the hands of strangers to plunder them, and to the pestilent ones of the earth for spoil, and they shall profane them.
verses.7:22: And I will turn My face away from them, and they shall defile My oversight, and they shall enter into them unguardedly and profane them,
verses.7:23: and they shall make confusion, for the land is full of peoples, and the city is full of lawlessness.
verses.7:24: And I will turn back the arrogance of their strength, and their holy places shall be defiled.
verses.7:25: Atonement shall come and seek peace, and there shall be none.
verses.7:26: Woe upon woe shall be, and report upon report shall be; and a vision shall be sought from a prophet, and law shall perish from a priest, and counsel from elders.
verses.7:27: A prince shall clothe himself with desolation, and the hands of the people of the land shall be paralyzed; according to their ways I will do to them, and in their judgments I will execute vengeance upon them, and they shall know that I am the Lord.'"
verses.8:1: And it came to pass in the sixth year, in the fifth month, on the fifth day of the month, I was sitting in the house, and the elders of Judah were sitting before me. And the hand of the Lord came upon me,
verses.8:2: and I looked, and behold, a likeness of a man: from His loins downward was fire, and from His loins upward was like the appearance of amber.
verses.8:3: And He stretched out the likeness of a hand and took me up by the crown of my head; and the Spirit lifted me up between earth and heaven and brought me to Jerusalem in a vision of God, to the entrance of the gate facing toward the north, where the pillar of the one who acquires stood.
verses.8:4: And behold, there was the glory of the Lord God of Israel, according to the vision which I saw in the plain.
verses.8:5: And He said to me, "Son of man, lift up your eyes toward the north." So I lifted up my eyes toward the north, and behold, from the north toward the gate of the one facing east.
verses.8:6: And He said to me, "Son of man, have you seen what these are doing? They are committing great lawless deeds here, so as to keep away from My sanctuary; and you shall yet see greater lawless deeds."
verses.8:7: And He brought me to the entrance of the court,
verses.8:8: and He said to me, "Son of man, dig." And I dug, and behold, a door.
verses.8:9: And He said to me, "Go in and see the lawless deeds which these are committing here."
verses.8:10: So I went in and looked, and behold, vain abominations and all the idols of the house of Israel portrayed upon it all around.
verses.8:11: And seventy men of the elders of the house of Israel were there; Jeconiah the son of Shaphan stood in the midst of them before them, and each man had his censer in his hand, and the vapor of the incense was ascending.
verses.8:12: And He said to me, "Have you seen, son of man, what the elders of the house of Israel are doing, each one of them in their hidden chamber? For they have said, 'The Lord does not see; the Lord has forsaken the land.'"
verses.8:13: And He said to me, "You shall yet see greater lawless deeds which these are committing."
verses.8:14: And He brought me to the entrance of the gate of the house of the Lord facing toward the north, and behold, women were sitting there, lamenting for Tammuz.
verses.8:15: And He said to me, "Son of man, have you seen? And you shall yet see practices greater than these."
verses.8:16: And He brought me into the inner court of the house of the Lord; and at the entrance of the temple of the Lord, between the porches and the altar, were about twenty men, with their backs toward the temple of the Lord and their faces opposite, and these were worshiping the sun.
verses.8:17: And He said to me, "Have you seen, son of man? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah to commit the lawless deeds which they have committed here? For they have filled the land with lawlessness, and behold, they are as those who mock.
verses.8:18: And I will deal with them in fury; My eye shall not spare, nor will I have mercy."
verses.9:1: And He cried out in my ears with a loud voice, saying, "The vengeance of the city has drawn near!" And each one had the weapons of destruction in his hand.
verses.9:2: And behold, six men came from the way of the upper gate which faces toward the north, and each man had an axe in his hand; and one man in the midst of them was clothed in a long robe, and a belt of sapphire was upon his loins; and they went in and stood beside the bronze altar.
verses.9:3: And the glory of the God of Israel ascended from the cherubim, upon which it was, to the open court of the house.
verses.9:4: And He called to the man clothed in the long robe, who had a belt upon his loins, and said to him, "Pass through the midst of Jerusalem, and set a mark upon the foreheads of the men who groan and who grieve over all the lawless deeds that are committed in their midst."
verses.9:5: And to these He said in my hearing, "Go after him into the city and strike; do not spare with your eyes, and do not have mercy.
verses.9:6: Slay old man and young man and maiden and little children and women to utter destruction, but do not draw near to anyone upon whom is the mark; begin at My sanctuary." And they began with the elder men who were inside the house.
verses.9:7: And He said to them, "Defile the house, and fill the streets with the dead as you go out, and strike."
verses.9:8: And it came to pass, while they were striking, that I fell upon my face, and cried out and said, "Alas, O Lord! Are You utterly destroying the remnant of Israel by pouring out Your fury upon Jerusalem?"
verses.9:9: And He said to me, "The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah has become exceedingly, exceedingly great, for the land has been filled with many peoples, and the city has been filled with iniquity and uncleanness; for they have said, 'The Lord has forsaken the land; the Lord does not look upon it.'
verses.9:10: And My eye shall not spare, nor will I have mercy; I have laid their ways upon their heads."
verses.9:11: And behold, the man who was clothed in the long robe and girded about his loins with the belt answered and said, "I have done just as You commanded me."
verses.10:1: And I looked, and behold, above the firmament that was over the head of the cherubim, like a sapphire stone, the likeness of a throne was above them.
verses.10:2: Then He spoke to the man clothed with the robe, "Go in among the wheels that are underneath the cherubim, fill your hands with coals of fire from the midst of the cherubim, and scatter them over the city." And he went in before my sight.
verses.10:3: Now the cherubim were standing on the right side of the house when the man went in, and the cloud filled the inner court.
verses.10:4: Then the glory of the Lord departed from the cherubim to the open court of the house; and the cloud filled the house, and the court was filled with the radiance of the glory of the Lord.
verses.10:5: And the sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard as far as the outer court, like the voice of God Shaddai speaking.
verses.10:6: And it came to pass, when He commanded the man clothed with the holy robe, saying, "Take fire from the midst of the wheels, from the midst of the cherubim," that he went in and stood beside the wheels.
verses.10:7: And he stretched forth his hand into the midst of the fire that was in the midst of the cherubim, and took some and put it into the hands of the one clothed with the holy robe; and he received it and went out.
verses.10:8: And I saw the cherubim: the likeness of the hands of men was underneath their wings.
verses.10:9: And I looked, and behold, four wheels were standing beside the cherubim, one wheel beside one cherub; and the appearance of the wheels was like the appearance of a carbuncle stone.
verses.10:10: And as for their appearance, all four had one likeness, just as when a wheel is in the midst of a wheel.
verses.10:11: When they went, they went toward their four sides; they did not turn as they went, for toward whatever place the foremost one looked, they went, and they did not turn as they went.
verses.10:12: And their backs, and their hands, and their wings, and the wheels were full of eyes all around on the four wheels.
verses.10:13: As for these wheels, they were called Gelgel in my hearing.
verses.10:15: And the cherubim were this living creature that I saw by the river Chebar.
verses.10:16: And when the cherubim went, the wheels went, and these were beside them; and when the cherubim lifted up their wings to rise up from the earth, their wheels did not turn.
verses.10:17: When they stood still, these stood still; and when they rose up, these rose up with them, for the spirit of life was in them.
verses.10:18: Then the glory of the Lord went forth from the house and mounted upon the cherubim.
verses.10:19: And the cherubim lifted up their wings and rose up from the earth before my sight; as they went forth, the wheels also were beside them; and they stood at the entrance of the gate of the house of the Lord facing opposite, and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.
verses.10:20: This is the living creature that I saw beneath the God of Israel by the river Chebar, and I knew that they were cherubim.
verses.10:21: Each one had four faces, and each one had eight wings, and the likeness of the hands of a man was underneath their wings.
verses.10:22: And as for the likeness of their faces, these are the faces that I saw beneath the glory of the God of Israel by the river Chebar; and each one of them went straight forward.
verses.11:1: Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the gate of the house of the Lord that is opposite, looking toward the east; and at the entrance of the gate were about twenty-five men, and I saw in their midst Jechoniah the son of Ezer and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, the leaders of the people.
verses.11:2: And the Lord said to me, "Son of man, these are the men who devise vain things and give wicked counsel in this city,
verses.11:3: who say, 'Have not the houses been built recently? This city is the cauldron, and we are the flesh.'
verses.11:4: Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy, O son of man!"
verses.11:5: Then the Spirit fell upon me and said to me, "Say, 'Thus says the Lord: Thus you have spoken, O house of Israel, and I know the thoughts of your spirit.
verses.11:6: You have multiplied your dead in this city, and you have filled their streets with the slain.
verses.11:7: Therefore thus says the Lord: Your dead whom you have struck down in her midst, they are the flesh, and this city is the cauldron; but I will bring you out of her midst.
verses.11:8: You fear the sword, and I will bring a sword upon you, says the Lord.
verses.11:9: And I will bring you out of her midst and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and I will execute judgments among you.
verses.11:10: You shall fall by the sword; on the mountains of Israel I will judge you, and you shall know that I am the Lord.'"
verses.11:13: And it came to pass, while I was prophesying, that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then I fell on my face, and cried out with a loud voice, and said, "Alas, alas, O Lord! Are You making a complete end of the remnant of Israel?"
verses.11:14: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.11:15: "Son of man, your brethren and the men of your captivity and all the house of Israel has come to an end, concerning whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, 'You are far away from the Lord; to us the land has been given for an inheritance.'
verses.11:16: Therefore say, 'Thus says the Lord: I will cast them off among the nations, and I will scatter them into every land, yet I will be to them a little sanctuary in the countries wherever they go.'
verses.11:17: Therefore say, 'Thus says the Lord: I will also receive them from the nations and gather them from the countries where I have scattered them, and I will give them the land of Israel.
verses.11:18: And they shall go there and remove all its abominations and all its iniquities from it.
verses.11:19: And I will give them another heart, and I will put a new spirit within them; and I will take out the stony heart from their flesh and give them a heart of flesh,
verses.11:20: that they may walk in My statutes and keep My ordinances and do them; and they shall be My people, and I will be their God.
verses.11:21: But as for the heart of their abominations and their iniquities, as their heart walked, I have brought their ways upon their own heads, says the Lord.'"
verses.11:22: Then the cherubim lifted up their wings, with the wheels beside them, and the glory of the God of Israel was over them, above them.
verses.11:23: And the glory of the Lord went up from the midst of the city and stood on the mountain that was opposite the city.
verses.11:24: Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me into the land of the Chaldeans, to the captivity, in a vision by the Spirit of God. And I went up from the vision that I had seen,
verses.11:25: and I spoke to the captivity all the words of the Lord that He had shown me.
verses.12:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.12:2: "Son of man, you dwell in the midst of their iniquities, who have eyes to see and do not see, and have ears to hear and do not hear; for it is a provoking house.
verses.12:3: Therefore, son of man, prepare for yourself baggage for captivity by day in their sight, and you shall be led captive from your place to another place in their sight, so that they may know that it is a provoking house.
verses.12:4: And you shall bring out your baggage, baggage for captivity, by day before their eyes; and you yourself shall go out in the evening as a captive goes forth
verses.12:5: in their sight; dig for yourself into the wall, and you shall go out through it.
verses.12:6: In their sight you shall be lifted up upon shoulders, and you shall go out concealed; you shall cover your face and shall by no means see the land, for I have set you as a sign to the house of Israel."
verses.12:7: And I did so, according to all that He commanded me: I brought out baggage for captivity by day, and in the evening I dug through the wall for myself, and I went out concealed; I was lifted up upon shoulders in their sight.
verses.12:8: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.12:9: "Son of man, has not the house of Israel, the provoking house, said to you, 'What are you doing?'
verses.12:10: Say to them, 'Thus says the Lord, the Lord: The ruler and the leader in Jerusalem, and to all the house of Israel who are in their midst'—
verses.12:11: say, 'I perform signs; just as I have done, so shall it be done to him: they shall go into deportation and into captivity.
verses.12:12: And the ruler in their midst shall be lifted up upon shoulders, and he shall go out concealed through the wall, and he shall dig through so that he may go out through it; he shall cover his face so that he may not be seen by any eye, and he himself shall not see the land.
verses.12:13: And I will spread My net over him, and he shall be caught in My snare; and I will bring him to Babylon, to the land of the Chaldeans, yet he shall not see it, and there he shall die.
verses.12:14: And all who are around him, his helpers, and all who uphold him, I will scatter to every wind; and I will unsheathe a sword after them.
verses.12:15: And they shall know that I am the Lord, when I scatter them among the nations and disperse them in the countries.
verses.12:16: Yet I will leave of them men few in number from the sword, from famine, and from death, so that they may recount all their iniquities among the nations where they have gone; and they shall know that I am the Lord.'"
verses.12:17: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.12:18: "Son of man, you shall eat your bread with anguish, and drink water with torment and affliction.
verses.12:19: And you shall say to the people of the land, 'Thus says the Lord to the inhabitants of Jerusalem in the land of Israel: They shall eat their bread with scarcity, and drink their water with desolation, so that the land may be made desolate with its fullness, for all who dwell in it are in ungodliness.
verses.12:20: And their inhabited cities shall be laid waste, and the land shall become a desolation; and you shall know that I am the Lord.'"
verses.12:21: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.12:22: "Son of man, what is this proverb that you have in the land of Israel, saying, 'The days are prolonged, and vision has perished'?
verses.12:23: Therefore say to them, 'Thus says the Lord: I will also turn away this proverb, and the house of Israel shall no longer speak this proverb'; for you shall speak to them, 'The days have drawn near, and the word of every vision.
verses.12:24: For there shall no longer be any false vision or one who divines flattering things in the midst of the children of Israel.
verses.12:25: For I, the Lord, will speak My words; I will speak and I will perform them, and I will no longer delay; for in your days, O provoking house, I will speak a word and perform it, says the Lord.'"
verses.12:26: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.12:27: "Son of man, behold, the provoking house of Israel keeps saying, 'The vision that this man sees is for many days to come, and he prophesies of times far off.'
verses.12:28: Therefore say to them, 'Thus says the Lord: None of My words that I speak shall be delayed any longer; I will speak and I will perform it, says the Lord.'"
verses.13:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.13:2: "Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel, and you shall prophesy and say to them, 'Hear the word of the Lord:
verses.13:3: Thus says the Lord: Woe to those who prophesy from their own heart, and do not see at all!
verses.13:4: Like foxes in the deserts are your prophets, O Israel!
verses.13:5: They did not stand in a firm place, and they gathered flocks against the house of Israel; those who say, "In the day of the Lord," did not rise up.
verses.13:6: Seeing falsehoods and divining vain things, they are those who say, "The Lord says," though the Lord has not sent them; and they began to establish a word.
verses.13:7: Have you not seen a false vision, and have you not spoken vain divinations?'
verses.13:8: Therefore say, 'Thus says the Lord: Because your words are false and your divinations are vain, therefore, behold, I am against you, says the Lord,
verses.13:9: and I will stretch out My hand against the prophets who see falsehoods and those who utter vain things; they shall not be in the instruction of My people, nor shall they be written in the register of the house of Israel, and they shall not enter into the land of Israel; and they shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.13:10: Because they led My people astray, saying, "Peace," and there was no peace; and this one builds a wall, and they plaster it—it shall fall.'
verses.13:11: Say to those who plaster it, 'It shall fall; and there shall be a flooding rain, and I will cast catapult stones into their joints, and they shall fall, and there shall be a sweeping wind, and it shall be torn apart.
verses.13:12: And behold, the wall has fallen; will they not say to you, "Where is your plaster with which you plastered it?"
verses.13:13: Therefore thus says the Lord: I will cause a sweeping blast to burst forth with fury, and a flooding rain shall come in My anger, and the catapult stones I will bring in fury to complete destruction,
verses.13:14: and I will tear down the wall which you plastered—it shall fall; and I will lay it to the ground, and its foundations shall be uncovered, and it shall fall, and you shall be consumed with reproofs; and you shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.13:15: And I will exhaust My fury against the wall and against those who plaster it—it shall fall. And I said to you, "The wall is no more, nor are those who plaster it,
verses.13:16: the prophets of Israel who prophesy concerning Jerusalem and who see peace for her, and there is no peace," says the Lord.'
verses.13:17: And you, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people who prophesy from their own heart, and prophesy against them,
verses.13:18: and you shall say, 'Thus says the Lord: Woe to the women who sew cushions under every elbow of the hand and make veils for every head of every stature, to pervert souls! The souls of My people were perverted, and they kept souls alive for themselves,
verses.13:19: and they profaned Me among My people for a handful of barley and for pieces of bread, to slay souls that ought not to die and to keep alive souls that ought not to live, by your uttering oracles to a people who listen to vain utterances.
verses.13:20: Therefore thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I am against your cushions, upon which you entangle souls there, and I will tear them away from your arms, and I will send out the souls—those whose souls you subvert—into dispersion,
verses.13:21: and I will tear apart your veils, and I will deliver My people out of your hand, and they shall no longer be in your hands for entanglement; and you shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.13:22: Because you perverted the heart of the righteous, though I did not pervert him, and strengthened the hands of the lawless so that he should not at all turn from his wicked way and live,
verses.13:23: therefore you shall by no means see falsehoods, and you shall no longer divine divinations; and I will deliver My people out of your hand, and you shall know that I am the Lord.'"
verses.14:1: And men from the elders of Israel came to me and sat before my face.
verses.14:2: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.14:3: "Son of man, these men have set their thoughts upon their hearts and have placed the punishment of their iniquities before their face. Shall I indeed answer them?
verses.14:4: Therefore speak to them, and you shall say to them, 'Thus says the Lord: Every man of the house of Israel who sets his thoughts upon his heart and places the punishment of his iniquity before his face, and comes to the prophet, I the Lord will answer him according to those things in which his mind is entangled,
verses.14:5: so that it may turn aside the house of Israel according to their hearts that are estranged from Me in their devisings.'
verses.14:6: Therefore say to the house of Israel, 'Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Return and turn away from your practices and from all your impieties, and turn your faces back.
verses.14:7: For every man of the house of Israel and of the strangers who sojourn in Israel who estranges himself from Me and sets his devisings upon his heart and places the punishment of his iniquity before his face, and comes to the prophet to inquire of him concerning Me, I the Lord will answer him by that in which he is entangled.
verses.14:8: And I will set My face against that man, and I will make him a desolation and an utter ruin, and I will cut him off from the midst of My people; and you shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.14:9: And if the prophet errs and speaks, I the Lord have led that prophet astray; and I will stretch out My hand against him and will destroy him from the midst of My people Israel.
verses.14:10: And they shall bear their iniquity; as is the wrongdoing of the one who inquires, so likewise shall the wrongdoing be for the prophet,
verses.14:11: that the house of Israel may no longer go astray from Me, and that they may no longer be defiled by all their transgressions; and they shall be to Me for a people, and I will be to them for a God, says the Lord.'"
verses.14:12: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.14:13: "Son of man, if a land sins against Me by committing a trespass, then I will stretch out My hand against it and break its staff of bread, and I will send famine upon it and cut off from it man and beasts.
verses.14:14: Even if these three men were in its midst—Noah, Daniel, and Job—they themselves shall be saved by their righteousness, says the Lord.
verses.14:15: If I also bring evil beasts upon the land and punish it, and it becomes a desolation, and there is no one passing through because of the beasts,
verses.14:16: even though these three men are in its midst, as I live, says the Lord, neither sons nor daughters shall be saved; rather, they alone shall be saved, and the land shall be given to destruction.
verses.14:17: Or if I also bring a sword upon that land and say, 'Let a sword pass through the land,' and I cut off from it man and beast,
verses.14:18: even though these three men are in its midst, as I live, says the Lord, they shall by no means deliver sons or daughters; they alone shall be saved.
verses.14:19: Or if I also send death upon that land, and pour out My fury upon it in blood to destroy from it man and beast,
verses.14:20: even though Noah, Daniel, and Job are in its midst, as I live, says the Lord, neither sons nor daughters shall be left behind; they themselves shall deliver their own souls by their righteousness.
verses.14:21: Thus says the Lord: Even if I send My four grievous judgments—sword and famine and evil beasts and death—upon Jerusalem to destroy from it man and beast,
verses.14:22: yet behold, there are left behind in it those of hers who have been rescued, who bring out from it sons and daughters; behold, they are coming out to you, and you shall see their ways
verses.14:23: and their devisings; and you shall know that I have not done in vain all that I have done in it, says the Lord."
verses.15:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.15:2: "And you, son of man, what could the wood of the vine become out of all the wood that is among the trees of the forest?
verses.15:3: Will they take wood from it to make for any work? Will they take a peg from it to hang any vessel upon it?
verses.15:4: Apart from this, it is given to fire for consumption; the fire consumes its yearly pruning from it, and it fails completely. Will it be useful for any work?
verses.15:5: Not even while it is still whole shall it be fit for any work; how much less, when fire also consumes it completely, will it still be fit for any work?
verses.15:6: Therefore say, 'Thus says the Lord: Just as the wood of the vine among the trees of the forest, which I have given to fire for consumption, so have I given the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.15:7: And I will set My face against them; they shall come out from the fire, yet fire shall devour them, and they shall know that I am the Lord when I set My face against them.
verses.15:8: And I will give the land over to desolation, because they have committed a trespass, says the Lord.'"
verses.16:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.16:2: "Son of man, bear witness to Jerusalem of her lawless deeds,
verses.16:3: and you shall say, Thus says the Lord to Jerusalem: Your root and your birth are from the land of Canaan; your father was an Amorite, and your mother a Hittite.
verses.16:4: And as for your birth: on the day you were born, you did not bind your breasts, and you were not washed in water, nor were you salted with salt, and you were not wrapped in swaddling cloths,
verses.16:5: nor did My eye spare you in any of these things, to feel anything for you; and you were cast out upon the face of the field in the crookedness of your soul, on the day you were born.
verses.16:6: And I passed by you and saw you defiled in the blood, and I said to you, 'Out of your blood, life!'
verses.16:7: Be multiplied! Like the growth of the field I have made you; and you were multiplied and grew great, and you entered into cities of cities. Your breasts became firm, and your hair grew, yet you were naked and unseemly.
verses.16:8: And I passed by you and saw you, and behold, it was your time, even a time of those who lodge; and I spread My wings over you and covered your unseemliness, and I swore to you and entered into a covenant with you, says the Lord, and you became Mine.
verses.16:9: And I washed you in water, and rinsed away your blood from you, and anointed you with oil;
verses.16:10: and I clothed you in embroidered garments and shod you with hyacinth, and I girded you with fine linen and wrapped you in delicate fabric;
verses.16:11: and I adorned you with ornaments, and put bracelets around your hands and a necklace around your neck;
verses.16:12: and I put a ring on your nose, and round earrings upon your ears, and a crown of glorying upon your head;
verses.16:13: and you were adorned with gold and silver, and your garments were of fine linen and delicate fabric and embroidered work; you ate fine flour and oil and honey, and you became exceedingly beautiful.
verses.16:14: And a name went forth for you among the nations on account of your beauty, for it was made perfect in splendor, in the loveliness which I set upon you, says the Lord.
verses.16:15: You trusted in your beauty and played the harlot because of your name, and poured out your harlotry upon every passerby.
verses.16:16: And you took some of your garments, and made for yourself stitched idols and committed harlotry upon them; and you shall by no means enter in, nor shall it come to pass.
verses.16:17: And you took the vessels of your glorying from My gold and from My silver, from what I gave you, and made for yourself male images and committed harlotry with them,
verses.16:18: and you took your embroidered apparel and clothed them, and you set My oil and My incense before their face,
verses.16:19: and My loaves which I gave you—fine flour and oil and honey I fed you—and you set them before their face for an aroma of sweet fragrance. And it came to pass, says the Lord,
verses.16:20: that you took your sons and your daughters whom you bore, and sacrificed them to them to be consumed; as a small matter you committed harlotry,
verses.16:21: and you slew your children and gave them up in making an expiatory offering of them to them.
verses.16:22: This was beyond all your harlotry, and you did not remember your infancy, the day when you were naked and unseemly; defiled in your blood, you lived.
verses.16:23: And it came to pass after all your wicked deeds, says the Lord,
verses.16:24: that you built for yourself a house of harlotry, and made for yourself a public place in every open square,
verses.16:25: and at the head of every way you built your houses of harlotry and degraded your beauty, and parted your legs to every passerby and multiplied your harlotry,
verses.16:26: and you committed harlotry with the sons of Egypt, your neighbors, great of flesh, and in many ways you committed harlotry, to provoke Me to anger.
verses.16:27: And if I stretch out My hand against you, then I will take away your ordinances and deliver you to the souls of those who hate you, the daughters of foreigners who turn you aside from your way. You acted impiously,
verses.16:28: and you committed harlotry with the daughters of Assyria, and not even so were you satisfied; and you committed harlotry, and you were not filled.
verses.16:29: And you multiplied your covenants with the land of the Chaldeans, and not even with these were you satisfied.
verses.16:30: How shall I deal with your daughter, says the Lord, when you do all these works of a harlot woman? And you committed harlotry threefold among your daughters;
verses.16:31: you built the house of harlotry at the head of every way, and you made your platform in every open square. And you became like a harlot gathering wages,
verses.16:32: the adulterous woman like you, receiving wages from her husband, was giving wages to all who committed harlotry with her;
verses.16:33: and you have given wages to all your lovers, and you loaded them down, that they might come to you from every side in your harlotry.
verses.16:34: And there came to be in you a perverted thing beyond other women in your harlotry, and with you they have committed harlotry in your giving wages, and wages were not given to you; and perverted things came to be in you.
verses.16:35: Therefore, O harlot, hear the word of the Lord:
verses.16:36: Thus says the Lord: Because you poured out your bronze, your shame shall also be uncovered in your harlotry toward your lovers, and toward all the devices of your lawless deeds, and in the blood of your children whom you gave to them.
verses.16:37: Therefore, behold, I am gathering together all your lovers with whom you mingled, and all whom you loved, together with all whom you hated; and I will gather them against you from every side and uncover your wicked deeds before them, and they shall see all your shame;
verses.16:38: and I will take vengeance on you with the vengeance of an adulteress, and I will set you in blood of wrath and jealousy.
verses.16:39: And I will deliver you into their hands, and they shall tear down your house of harlotry and pull down your platform, and they shall strip you of your garments and take the vessels of your glorying, and leave you naked and unseemly.
verses.16:40: And they shall bring multitudes against you, and they shall stone you with stones, and slaughter you with their swords,
verses.16:41: and they shall burn your houses with fire, and execute acts of vengeance upon you before many women; and I will turn you away from harlotry, and you shall by no means give wages anymore.
verses.16:42: And I will let loose My wrath upon you, and My jealousy shall be taken away from you; and I will rest, and I will by no means be anxious anymore.
verses.16:43: Because you did not remember your infancy, and you grieved Me in all these things, behold, I also have put your ways upon your head, says the Lord; and thus you have committed impiety upon all your lawless deeds.
verses.16:44: These are all the things which they have spoken against you in a proverb, saying, 'As is the mother,
verses.16:45: so is the daughter.' You are your mother's daughter, who cast off her husband and her children, and the sisters of your sisters, who cast off their husbands and their children; your mother was a Hittite, and your father an Amorite.
verses.16:46: Your elder sister is Samaria, she and her daughters, who dwells on your left; and your sister, younger than you, who dwells on your right, is Sodom and her daughters.
verses.16:47: And not even so did you walk in their ways, nor did you act according to their lawless deeds; within a little you even surpassed them in all your ways.
verses.16:48: As I live, says the Lord, Sodom, she and her daughters, has not done as you and your daughters have done.
verses.16:49: Moreover, this was the iniquity of Sodom your sister: pride; in fullness of bread and in abundance she and her daughters lived in wanton luxury; this belonged to her and to her daughters; and they did not uphold the hand of the poor and needy,
verses.16:50: and they were haughty and committed iniquities before Me, and I took them away as I saw.
verses.16:51: And Samaria did not sin according to half of your sins; and you multiplied your lawless deeds beyond them, and justified your sisters by all your lawless deeds which you have done.
verses.16:52: You also, bear your torment by which you corrupted your sisters in your sins in which you acted lawlessly beyond them, and you justified them beyond yourself; you also, be ashamed and receive your dishonor in your justifying your sisters.
verses.16:53: And I will turn back their turnings—the turning of Sodom and her daughters, and I will turn back the turning of Samaria and her daughters, and I will turn back your turning in their midst,
verses.16:54: so that you may bear your torment and be put to dishonor because of all that you have done in provoking Me to anger.
verses.16:55: And your sister Sodom and her daughters shall be restored as they were from the beginning; and you and your daughters shall be restored as you were from the beginning.
verses.16:56: And if Sodom your sister was not a report in your mouth in the days of your pride,
verses.16:57: before your wicked deeds were uncovered, even as now you are a reproach to the daughters of Syria and of all those around her, the daughters of foreigners who surround you on every side,
verses.16:58: your impieties and your lawless deeds, you have borne them, says the Lord.
verses.16:59: Thus says the Lord: I will even do to you as you have done, since you dishonored these things to transgress My covenant.
verses.16:60: Yet I will remember My covenant with you in the days of your infancy, and I will establish for you an everlasting covenant.
verses.16:61: And you shall remember your way, and be utterly put to dishonor when you receive your sisters, those older than you together with those younger than you; and I will give them to you for building up, and not out of your covenant.
verses.16:62: And I will establish My covenant with you, and you shall know that I am the Lord;
verses.16:63: so that you may remember and be ashamed, and never open your mouth anymore because of your dishonor, when I make atonement for you according to all that you have done, says the Lord."
verses.17:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.17:2: "Son of man, recount a tale and speak a parable to the house of Israel,
verses.17:3: and you shall say, 'Thus says the Lord: The great eagle with great wings, long in span, full of talons, who has the design to enter into Lebanon—he took the choicest parts of the cedar,
verses.17:4: the tips of the tender shoots he plucked off, and he carried them into the land of Canaan; in a walled city he set them.
verses.17:5: And he took of the seed of the land and put it in the plain as a plant beside abundant water; as a thing watched over he appointed it.
verses.17:6: And it sprang up and became a weak and small vine, so that it might display its branches toward it, and its roots were beneath it. So it became a vine, and put forth shoots, and stretched out its trailing branches.
verses.17:7: And there was another great eagle, with great wings and many talons; and behold, this vine was entwined toward him, and its roots were toward him, and it sent forth its branches to him, that he might water it together with the clod of its planting.
verses.17:8: In a good plain beside abundant water it thrives, to produce sprouts and bear fruit, to become a great vine.'
verses.17:9: Therefore say, 'Thus says the Lord: Shall it prosper? Shall not the roots of its tenderness and the fruit rot, and shall not all its early sprouts wither, and not with a mighty arm nor with many people to tear it up from its roots?
verses.17:10: And behold, it thrives; shall it indeed prosper? Shall it not, the moment the scorching wind touches it, be withered? Together with the clod of its sprouting it shall wither away.'"
verses.17:11: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.17:12: "Son of man, say now to the provoking house, 'Do you not know what these things were?' Say, 'When the king of Babylon comes against Jerusalem, he shall take her king and her rulers and bring them to himself to Babylon.
verses.17:13: And he shall take of the seed of the kingdom, and make a covenant with him, and bring him under a curse; and the leaders of the land he shall take,
verses.17:14: that it may become a weak kingdom, not lifting itself up at all, so as to keep his covenant and uphold it.
verses.17:15: Yet he shall revolt from him by sending out his own messengers to Egypt, that it may give him horses and many people. Shall he prosper? Shall the one who does contrary things be delivered? And transgressing a covenant, shall he be delivered?
verses.17:16: As I live, says the Lord, surely in the place of the king who made him king—he who dishonored My curse and who transgressed My covenant—with him in the midst of Babylon he shall die.
verses.17:17: And neither with a mighty force nor with a great throng shall Pharaoh wage war with him, in the casting up of a rampart and in the building of siege-engines to cut off souls.
verses.17:18: And he dishonored an oath by transgressing a covenant; and behold, I have given his hand, and all these things he has done to him; shall he be saved?'
verses.17:19: Therefore say, 'Thus says the Lord: As I live, surely My oath which he dishonored, and My covenant which he transgressed—I will indeed bring it upon his own head.
verses.17:20: And I will spread out the net over him, and he shall be caught in his snare.
verses.17:21: In all his battle array they shall fall by the sword, and the remnant I will scatter to every wind; and you shall know that I, the Lord, have spoken.
verses.17:22: For thus says the Lord: I Myself will also take from the choice shoots of the cedar, from the top; their hearts I will pluck off, and I Myself will plant them upon a high mountain,
verses.17:23: and I will suspend it on the lofty mountain of Israel and plant it; and it shall bring forth a sprout and produce fruit and become a great cedar; and every bird shall rest beneath it, and every winged creature shall rest under its shadow; its branches shall be restored.
verses.17:24: And all the trees of the plain shall know that I am the Lord, who brings low the high tree and exalts the low tree, and dries up the green tree and makes the dry tree flourish. I, the Lord, have spoken, and I will do it.'"
verses.18:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.18:2: "Son of man, what is this parable to you among the sons of Israel, saying, 'The fathers ate sour grapes, and the teeth of the children were set on edge'?
verses.18:3: As I live, says the Lord, this parable shall surely no longer be spoken in Israel.
verses.18:4: For all souls are Mine; just as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son—they are Mine; the soul that sins, it shall die.
verses.18:5: Now the man who shall be righteous, who practices righteousness,
verses.18:6: shall not eat upon the mountains, and shall by no means lift up his eyes toward the devices of the house of Israel, and shall by no means defile his neighbor's wife, and shall not draw near to a woman in her impurity,
verses.18:7: and shall not oppress any man, shall restore the pledge of a debtor, and shall not seize plunder, shall give his bread to the hungry and clothe the naked,
verses.18:8: and shall not lend his silver upon interest, nor take increase, and shall turn back his hand from unrighteousness, shall execute righteous judgment between a man and his neighbor,
verses.18:9: and has walked in My statutes, has kept My ordinances to do them—this man is righteous; he shall surely live, says the Lord.
verses.18:10: And if he fathers a pestilent son, who sheds blood and commits sin,
verses.18:11: he did not walk in the way of his righteous father, but even ate upon the mountains and defiled his neighbor's wife,
verses.18:12: and oppressed the poor and needy, and seized plunder, and did not restore a pledge, and set his eyes upon the idols, has practiced lawlessness,
verses.18:13: lent with interest and took increase—this man shall surely not live! He has done all these lawless deeds; he shall surely be put to death; his blood shall be upon him.
verses.18:14: Now if he fathers a son, and he sees all the sins of his father which he committed, and fears, and does not act according to them—
verses.18:15: he has not eaten upon the mountains, and has not set his eyes upon the devices of the house of Israel, and has not defiled his neighbor's wife,
verses.18:16: and has not oppressed any man, and has not exacted a pledge, and has not seized plunder, has given his bread to the hungry and clothed the naked,
verses.18:17: and has turned back his hand from unrighteousness, has taken neither interest nor increase, has practiced righteousness and walked in My statutes—he shall not die in the iniquities of his father; he shall surely live.
verses.18:18: As for his father, if he grievously oppresses and seizes plunder—he has done contrary things in the midst of My people—he shall die in his iniquity.
verses.18:19: Yet you will say, 'Why has the son not borne the iniquity of the father?' Because the son has practiced righteousness and mercy, has carefully kept all My ordinances and done them, he shall surely live.
verses.18:20: The soul that sins shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, nor shall the father bear the iniquity of the son; the righteousness of the righteous shall be upon him, and the lawlessness of the lawless shall be upon him.
verses.18:21: And if the lawless man turns back from all his lawless deeds which he has committed, and keeps all My commandments, and practices righteousness and mercy, he shall surely live; he shall by no means die.
verses.18:22: All his transgressions which he has committed shall not be remembered; in his righteousness which he has practiced he shall live.
verses.18:23: Do I indeed delight in the death of the lawless, says the Lord, rather than that he should turn back from the evil way and live?
verses.18:24: But when a righteous man turns back from his righteousness and commits unrighteousness according to all the lawless deeds which the lawless man has committed, all his righteous deeds which he has done shall by no means be remembered; in his transgression by which he transgressed and in his sins which he sinned, in them he shall die.
verses.18:25: Yet you said, 'The way of the Lord is not straight.' Hear now, O house of Israel: Is My way not straight? Is it not your way that is not straight?
verses.18:26: When the righteous man turns back from his righteousness and commits a transgression, and dies in the transgression which he has committed, in it he shall die.
verses.18:27: And when a lawless man turns back from his lawlessness which he has committed and practices judgment and righteousness, this man has preserved his soul.
verses.18:28: And he has turned back from all his ungodly deeds which he committed; he shall surely live, he shall by no means die.
verses.18:29: Yet the house of Israel says, 'The way of the Lord is not upright.' Is My way not upright, O house of Israel? Is it not your way that is not upright?
verses.18:30: Each one according to his way I will judge you, O house of Israel, says the Lord. Return and turn away from all your ungodly deeds, and they shall not become to you a punishment of iniquity.
verses.18:31: Cast away from yourselves all your ungodly deeds by which you have acted impiously against Me, and make for yourselves a new heart and a new spirit; and why do you die, O house of Israel?
verses.18:32: For I do not desire the death of the one who is dying, says the Lord."
verses.19:1: And you, take up a lamentation for the ruler of Israel,
verses.19:2: and you shall say, "What is your mother? A lion cub; in the midst of lions she came into being, in the midst of lions she multiplied her cubs.
verses.19:3: And one of her cubs sprang forth; he became a lion, and he learned to seize prey; he devoured men.
verses.19:4: And nations heard against him; in their destruction he was caught, and they brought him in a muzzle into the land of Egypt.
verses.19:5: And she saw that he had been thrust away from her, her hope had perished; and she took another of her cubs, and appointed him a lion.
verses.19:6: And he went about in the midst of lions; he became a lion, and he learned to seize prey; he devoured men.
verses.19:7: And he fed in his boldness and laid waste their cities, and he made the land and its fullness desolate at the sound of his roaring.
verses.19:8: Then nations from the lands round about set against him, and they spread their nets over him; in their destruction he was caught.
verses.19:9: And they put him in a muzzle and in a cage; he came to the king of Babylon, and he brought him into prison, so that his voice might not be heard upon the mountains of Israel.
verses.19:10: Your mother was like a vine and like a blossom on a pomegranate tree, planted by water; her fruit and her sprout came from abundant water.
verses.19:11: And she became a rod over a tribe of rulers, and she was exalted in her stature in the midst of tree trunks, and she saw her stature in the multitude of her branches.
verses.19:12: Yet she was broken down in wrath; to the ground she was cast down, and the scorching wind dried up her choice shoots; vengeance was taken upon them, and the rod of her strength was withered; fire consumed her.
verses.19:13: And now they have planted her in the wilderness, in a waterless land.
verses.19:14: And fire went forth from a rod of her choice shoots and devoured her, and there was in her no rod of strength; a tribe is for a parable of lamentation, and it shall be for a lamentation."
verses.20:1: And it came to pass in the seventh year, on the fifteenth of the month, that men from the elders of the house of Israel came to inquire of the Lord, and they sat before me.
verses.20:2: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.20:3: "Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel, and you shall say to them, 'Thus says the Lord: Have you come to inquire of Me? As I live, I will surely not answer you, says the Lord,
verses.20:4: nor will I surely avenge them.' Son of man, testify to them concerning the iniquities of their fathers,
verses.20:5: and you shall say to them, 'Thus says the Lord: From the day that I chose the house of Israel, and made Myself known to the seed of the house of Jacob, and became known to them in the land of Egypt, and took hold of them with My hand, saying, "I am the Lord your God,"
verses.20:6: in that day I took hold of them with My hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt into the land which I had prepared for them, a land flowing with milk and honey—it is a honeycomb above all the earth.
verses.20:7: And I said to them, "Let each one cast away the abominations of his eyes, and do not defile yourselves with the practices of Egypt; I am the Lord your God."
verses.20:8: Yet they turned away from Me and were not willing to listen to Me; they did not cast away the abominations of their eyes, nor did they forsake the practices of Egypt. Then I said I would pour out My fury upon them, to accomplish My wrath against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.
verses.20:9: Yet I acted so that My name would not be profaned at all before the nations in whose midst they were, among whom I made Myself known to them in their sight, to bring them out of the land of Egypt.
verses.20:10: And I led them into the wilderness,
verses.20:11: and I gave them My statutes and made My ordinances known to them, all which a man shall do and live by them.
verses.20:12: Moreover I gave them My Sabbaths, to be a sign between Me and them, that they might know that I am the Lord who sanctifies them.
verses.20:13: And I said to the house of Israel in the wilderness, "Walk in My statutes." Yet they did not walk in them, and they rejected My ordinances, which a man shall do and live by them, and they greatly profaned My Sabbaths. Then I said I would pour out My fury upon them in the wilderness, to consume them.
verses.20:14: Yet I acted so that My name would not be profaned at all before the nations, in whose sight I had brought them out.
verses.20:15: And I lifted up My hand against them in the wilderness, that I would not at all bring them into the land which I had given them, a land flowing with milk and honey—it is a honeycomb above all the earth—
verses.20:16: because they rejected My ordinances and did not walk in My statutes, and they profaned My Sabbaths and went after the devices of their heart.
verses.20:17: Nevertheless My eye spared them from blotting them out, and I did not make a full end of them in the wilderness.
verses.20:18: And I said to their children in the wilderness, "Do not walk in the laws of your fathers, nor keep their ordinances, and do not mingle with their practices nor defile yourselves.
verses.20:19: I am the Lord your God; walk in My statutes, and keep My ordinances and do them,
verses.20:20: and sanctify My Sabbaths, and let it be a sign between Me and you, that you may know that I am the Lord your God."
verses.20:21: Yet their children also provoked Me to bitterness; they did not walk in My statutes, nor did they keep My ordinances to do them, which a man shall do and live by them, and they profaned My Sabbaths. Then I said I would pour out My fury upon them in the wilderness, to accomplish My wrath upon them.
verses.20:22: Yet I acted so that My name would not be profaned at all before the nations, and I brought them out in their sight.
verses.20:23: And I lifted up My hand against them in the wilderness, to scatter them among the nations, to disperse them throughout the countries,
verses.20:24: because they did not do My ordinances, and they rejected My statutes, and they profaned My Sabbaths, and their eyes were after the devices of their fathers.
verses.20:25: And I also gave them statutes that were not good, and ordinances by which they shall not live.
verses.20:26: And I will defile them in their gifts, when I pass through all that opens the womb, so that I may destroy them.'
verses.20:27: Therefore speak to the house of Israel, son of man, and you shall say to them, 'Thus says the Lord: Up to this point your fathers provoked Me to anger by their trespasses in which they trespassed against Me.
verses.20:28: And I brought them into the land which I had lifted up My hand to give them; and they saw every high hill and every shady tree, and they sacrificed there to their gods, and they set there a sweet aroma, and poured out there their drink offerings.
verses.20:29: And I said to them, "What is Abana, that you enter there?" And they called its name Abana to this very day.'
verses.20:30: Therefore say to the house of Israel, 'Thus says the Lord: Are you defiling yourselves in the iniquities of your fathers, and do you commit harlotry after their abominations?
verses.20:31: And in the firstfruits of your gifts, in the dedicated offerings by which you defile yourselves in all your devices to this very day? And shall I answer you, O house of Israel? As I live, says the Lord, I will surely not answer you, nor shall this arise in your spirit.
verses.20:32: And it shall not be as you say, "We will be like the nations and like the tribes of the earth, to serve wood and stones."
verses.20:33: Therefore, as I live, says the Lord, with a mighty hand, and with an uplifted arm, and with fury poured out, I will reign over you,
verses.20:34: and I will bring you out from the peoples and receive you from the countries where you were scattered, with a mighty hand and an uplifted arm, and with fury poured out.
verses.20:35: And I will lead you into the wilderness of the peoples, and there I will enter into judgment with you face to face.
verses.20:36: Just as I entered into judgment with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will judge you, says the Lord.
verses.20:37: And I will cause you to pass under My rod, and I will bring you in by number,
verses.20:38: and I will expose from among you the ungodly and those who have revolted; for out of their sojourning I will bring them forth, yet they shall not enter into the land of Israel; and you shall know that I am the Lord, the Lord.
verses.20:39: And as for you, O house of Israel, thus says the Lord, the Lord: Put away, each one of you, his practices; and afterward, if you do not listen to Me, yet you shall no longer profane My holy name with your gifts and with your practices,
verses.20:40: for on My holy mountain, on a high mountain, says the Lord, the Lord, there all the house of Israel shall serve Me to the end. And there I will accept and there I will look upon your firstfruits and the firstfruits of your dedicated offerings, with all your consecrated things.
verses.20:41: With a sweet aroma I will accept you, when I bring you out from the peoples and receive you from the countries in which you were scattered; and I will be sanctified in you in the sight of the peoples.
verses.20:42: And you shall know that I am the Lord, when I bring you into the land of Israel, into the land which I lifted up My hand to give to your fathers.
verses.20:43: And there you shall remember your ways and your practices by which you defiled yourselves, and you shall beat your faces for all your evils.
verses.20:44: And you shall know that I am the Lord, when I deal thus with you so that My name may not be profaned according to your evil ways and according to your corrupt practices, says the Lord.'"
verses.21:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.21:2: "Son of man, set your face toward Teman, and look toward Dagon, and prophesy against the chief forest of the Negeb,
verses.21:3: and you shall say to the forest of the Negeb, 'Hear the word of the Lord! Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I kindle a fire in you, and it shall devour in you the green tree and every dry tree. The kindled flame shall not be quenched, and every face from the east to the north shall be burned by it.
verses.21:4: And all flesh shall know that I, the Lord, have kindled it; it shall not be quenched.'"
verses.21:5: Then I said, "By no means, O Lord, Lord! They say to me, 'Is this not a parable that is being spoken?'"
verses.21:6: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.21:7: "Therefore prophesy, son of man; set your face toward Jerusalem and look upon their holy places, and you shall prophesy against the land of Israel.
verses.21:8: And you shall say to the land of Israel, 'Behold, I am against you, and I will draw My sword out of its sheath, and I will destroy from you the unrighteous and the lawless.
verses.21:9: Because I will destroy from you the unrighteous and the lawless, therefore My sword shall go forth out of its sheath against all flesh from the east to the north,
verses.21:10: and all flesh shall know that I, the Lord, have drawn My sword out of its sheath; it shall not return anymore.'
verses.21:11: And you, son of man, groan deeply with the breaking of your loins, and in anguish you shall groan before their eyes.
