verses.21:12: And it shall come to pass, if they say to you, 'Why are you groaning?' then you shall say, 'Because of the report, for it is coming; and every heart shall be shattered, and all hands shall grow feeble, and all flesh and every spirit shall faint, and all thighs shall be defiled with moisture. Behold, it is coming, says the Lord, the Lord.'"
verses.21:13: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.21:14: "Son of man, prophesy and you shall say, 'Thus says the Lord: Say, Sword, sword, be sharpened and be enraged,
verses.21:15: that you may slaughter victims; be sharpened that you may become gleaming, ready for destruction. Slay, despise, cast aside every tree!
verses.21:16: And he has given it ready for his hand to grasp; the sword has been whetted, it is ready to be given into the hand of the slayer.'
verses.21:17: Cry out and wail, son of man, for this has come among My people, it is among all the leaders of Israel; they shall dwell as sojourners—by the sword it has come among My people! Therefore strike upon your hand,
verses.21:18: for it has been justified; and shall a tribe be cast aside? It shall not be, says the Lord, the Lord.
verses.21:19: And you, son of man, prophesy and strike hand against hand, and double the sword; the third is a sword of the slain, the great sword of the slain. And you shall strike them with terror,
verses.21:20: that the heart may not be shattered, and that the weak may be multiplied at every gate. They have been delivered up to the slaughter of the sword; well is it made for slaughter, well is it made for gleaming.
verses.21:21: Pass through, be sharpened on the right and on the left, wherever your face is roused.
verses.21:22: And I also will strike My hand against My hand, and I will let loose My wrath; I, the Lord, have spoken."
verses.21:23: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.21:24: "And you, son of man, appoint for yourself two roads for the sword of the king of Babylon to enter; both of them shall go forth from one land. And a signpost at the head of the road to a city—at the head of the road you shall appoint it—for the sword to enter against Rabbath of the sons of Ammon, and against Judea, and against Jerusalem in the midst of her,
verses.21:25: for a sword to enter against Rabbath of the sons of Ammon, and against Judea, and against Jerusalem in the midst of her.
verses.21:26: For the king of Babylon shall stand upon the ancient road, at the head of the two roads, to practice divination, to shake the rod, and to inquire of the carved images, and to inspect the liver on his right.
verses.21:27: The divination came against Jerusalem, to cast up a palisade, to open the mouth in a war cry, to lift up the voice with shouting, to set up a palisade against her gates, and to cast up a mound, and to build siege towers.
verses.21:28: And he is to them like one practicing divination before them, and he brings his iniquities to remembrance, that they may be remembered.
verses.21:29: Therefore thus says the Lord: 'Because you have brought your iniquities to remembrance, in that your ungodly deeds have been uncovered, so that your sins are seen in all your impieties and in your practices—because you have brought them to remembrance, by these you shall be captured.
verses.21:30: And you, O lawless, profane leader of Israel, whose day has come in the time of the end of iniquity,
verses.21:31: thus says the Lord: You have removed the turban and put on the crown; it shall not remain like this for her. You have humbled what is high, and you have exalted what is low.
verses.21:32: Iniquity, iniquity, iniquity I will make her! Woe to her! Such shall she be until he comes to whom it belongs, and I will deliver it to him.'
verses.21:33: And you, son of man, prophesy and say, 'Thus says the Lord concerning the sons of Ammon and concerning their reproach,' and you shall say, 'Sword, sword, drawn for slaughter and drawn for utter destruction, rise up that you may gleam!
verses.21:34: In your vain vision and in your divining of lies, to deliver you over upon the necks of the lawless slain, the day has come in the time of the end of iniquity.
verses.21:35: Turn back; do not lodge in this place where you were born. In your own land I will judge you.
verses.21:36: And I will pour out My wrath upon you; in the fire of My wrath I will blow upon you, and I will deliver you into the hands of barbarous men, contrivers of destruction.
verses.21:37: In the fire you shall be consumed; your blood shall be in the midst of your land. There shall by no means be remembrance of you, for I, the Lord, have spoken.'"
verses.22:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.22:2: "And you, son of man, will you judge the city of bloodshed? Then declare to her all her lawless deeds,
verses.22:3: and you shall say, 'Thus says the Lord, the Lord: O city that sheds blood in her midst so that her time may come, and makes devices against herself to defile herself!
verses.22:4: By their blood which you have shed you have transgressed, and by your devices which you have made you have been defiled; and you have brought your days near, and have brought on the time of your years. Therefore I have given you over as a reproach to the nations and as a mockery to all the lands that are near to you
verses.22:5: and to those that are far away from you; and they shall mock at you, O unclean one, renowned and abounding in lawless deeds!
verses.22:6: Behold, the leaders of the house of Israel, each one with his own kindred, have conspired together in you to shed blood.
verses.22:7: Father and mother they have reviled in you, and with the sojourner they have dealt in injustices in you; the fatherless and the widow they have oppressed,
verses.22:8: and My holy things they have despised, and My Sabbaths they have profaned in you.
verses.22:9: Men who are robbers are in you, in order to shed blood in you; and upon the mountains they have eaten in you; unholy deeds they have practiced in your midst.
verses.22:10: A father's shame they have uncovered in you, and her who was set apart in uncleanness they have humbled in you.
verses.22:11: Each one has acted lawlessly toward his neighbor's wife, and each one has defiled his daughter-in-law in ungodliness, and each one has humbled his sister, his father's daughter, in you.
verses.22:12: Bribes they have taken in you in order to shed blood; interest and excessive gain they have taken in you. And you have brought to completion the fullness of your wickedness in oppression, and Me you have forgotten, says the Lord.
verses.22:13: Now if I bring My hand upon the things you have accomplished which you have done, and upon your bloodshed that has taken place in your midst,
verses.22:14: shall your heart endure? Shall your hands prevail in the days in which I deal with you? I, the Lord, have spoken, and I will do it.
verses.22:15: And I will scatter you among the nations, and disperse you through the lands, and your uncleanness shall cease from you,
verses.22:16: and I will take an inheritance in you before the eyes of the nations; and you shall know that I am the Lord.'"
verses.22:17: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.22:18: "Son of man, behold, the house of Israel has become to Me mixed together—all of them with bronze and iron and tin and lead; in the midst of silver it is mixed.
verses.22:19: Therefore say, 'Thus says the Lord: Because you have become one mixture, therefore I will receive you into the midst of Jerusalem.
verses.22:20: Just as silver and bronze and iron and tin and lead are received into the midst of a furnace, to blow fire upon it so that it may be smelted, so I will receive you in My wrath, and I will gather and smelt you,
verses.22:21: and I will blow upon you in the fire of My wrath, and you shall be smelted in the midst of her.
verses.22:22: In the manner that silver is smelted in the midst of a furnace, so shall you be smelted in the midst of her; and you shall know that I, the Lord, have poured out My fury upon you.'"
verses.22:23: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.22:24: "Son of man, say to her, 'You are a land that is not watered with rain, nor has rain come upon you in the day of wrath,
verses.22:25: whose leaders in her midst are like roaring lions seizing prey, devouring souls by might and taking tribute; and your widows have been multiplied in your midst.'
verses.22:26: And her priests have rejected My law and profaned My holy things; between the holy and the profane they made no distinction, and between the unclean and the clean they made no distinction, and from My Sabbaths they veiled their eyes, and I was profaned in their midst.
verses.22:27: Her rulers in her midst are like wolves seizing prey to shed blood, that with greed they may gain dishonest profit.
verses.22:28: And her prophets who plaster them shall fall, seeing vain visions, divining lies, saying, 'Thus says the Lord,' when the Lord has not spoken—
verses.22:29: extorting the people of the land with injustice and plundering spoils, oppressing the poor and the needy, and not dealing with the sojourner with justice.
verses.22:30: And I sought from among them a man conducting himself uprightly and standing before My face wholeheartedly in the time of the land, so that I should not utterly blot her out; and I found none.
verses.22:31: And I have poured out My fury upon her in the fire of My wrath to consume her; their own ways I have brought upon their own heads, says the Lord, the Lord."
verses.23:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.23:2: "Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother,
verses.23:3: and they committed harlotry in Egypt in their youth; there their breasts fell, there they were deflowered.
verses.23:4: And their names were Oholah the elder, and Oholibah her sister. And they became Mine, and they bore sons and daughters. And as for their names: Samaria was Oholah, and Jerusalem was Oholibah.
verses.23:5: And Oholah committed harlotry away from Me, and she lusted after her lovers, after the Assyrians who drew near to her,
verses.23:6: clothed in blue, governors and commanders; young men and choice ones, all of them horsemen riding upon horses.
verses.23:7: And she gave her harlotry upon them, all of them choice sons of the Assyrians; and with all whom she lusted after, she defiled herself in all her devices.
verses.23:8: And she did not forsake her harlotry from Egypt, for they lay with her in her youth, and they deflowered her and poured out their harlotry upon her.
verses.23:9: Therefore I delivered her into the hands of her lovers, into the hands of the sons of the Assyrians, whom she lusted after.
verses.23:10: They uncovered her shame, they took her sons and her daughters, and her they slew with the sword; and she became a byword among women, and they executed judgments upon her among the daughters.
verses.23:11: And her sister Oholibah saw it, and she corrupted her lust more than she, and her harlotry more than the harlotry of her sister.
verses.23:12: She lusted after the sons of the Assyrians, governors and commanders who were near to her, clothed in finely bordered garments, horsemen riding upon horses, all of them choice young men.
verses.23:13: And I saw that she was defiled; one way belonged to both of them.
verses.23:14: And she added to her harlotry, and she saw men painted upon the wall, images of Chaldeans, depicted with a stylus,
verses.23:15: girded with embroidered bands upon their loins, and dyed cloths also upon their heads, all of them having a threefold appearance, the likeness of the sons of the Chaldeans, the land of his birth.
verses.23:16: And she lusted after them at the sight of her eyes, and she sent messengers to them into the land of the Chaldeans.
verses.23:17: And the sons of Babylon came to her into the bed of lodgers, and they defiled her in her harlotry; and she was defiled by them, and her soul turned away from them.
verses.23:18: And she uncovered her harlotry, and she uncovered her shame; and My soul turned away from her, just as My soul turned away from her sister.
verses.23:19: And you multiplied your harlotry, to call to remembrance the day of your youth, in which you committed harlotry in Egypt,
verses.23:20: and you lusted after the Chaldeans, whose flesh is like the flesh of donkeys, and whose private parts are the private parts of horses;
verses.23:21: and you revisited the iniquity of your youth, the things which you did in Egypt in your lodging place, where the breasts of your youth were.
verses.23:22: Therefore, Oholibah, thus says the Lord: 'Behold, I raise up your lovers against you, from whom your soul turned away, and I will bring them against you from every side:
verses.23:23: the sons of Babylon and all the Chaldeans, Phakouk and Soue and Hychoue, and all the sons of the Assyrians with them, choice young men, governors and commanders, all of them triple-ranked officers and men of renown, riding upon horses.
verses.23:24: And all of them shall come against you from the north, chariots and wheels with a multitude of peoples, shields and bucklers, and he shall set a watch against you all around.
verses.23:25: And I will set judgment before their face, and they shall execute vengeance upon you with their judgments; and I will set My jealousy against you, and they shall deal with you in the wrath of fury; they shall take away your nose and your ears, and your remnant they shall cast down with the sword. They shall take your sons and your daughters, and fire shall devour your remnant.
verses.23:26: And they shall strip you of your garments, and they shall take away the ornaments of your boasting.
verses.23:27: And I will turn away your impieties from you and your harlotry from the land of Egypt, and you shall by no means lift up your eyes toward them, and you shall remember Egypt no more.'
verses.23:28: For thus says the Lord, the Lord: 'Behold, I deliver you into the hands of those whom you hate, from whom your soul turned away;
verses.23:29: and they shall deal with you in hatred, and they shall take all your labors and your toils, and you shall be naked and ashamed, and the shame of your harlotry and your impiety shall be uncovered. And your harlotry
verses.23:30: has done these things to you, because you committed harlotry after the nations, and you defiled yourself with their devices.
verses.23:31: You have walked in the way of your sister, and I will put her cup into your hands.'
verses.23:32: Thus says the Lord: 'You shall drink the cup of your sister, the deep and the wide, and the overflowing one to bring drunkenness to the full,
verses.23:33: and you shall be filled with faintness; and the cup of desolation is the cup of your sister, and you shall drink it,
verses.23:34: and her feasts and her new moons I will turn away; for I have spoken,' says the Lord.
verses.23:35: Therefore thus says the Lord: 'Because you have forgotten Me and have cast Me behind your body, you also receive your impiety and your harlotry.'"
verses.23:36: And the Lord said to me, "Son of man, will you not judge Oholah and Oholibah? And you shall declare to them their iniquities,
verses.23:37: for they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands; they committed adultery with their devices, and their children whom they bore to Me they caused to pass to them through the sacrificial fires.
verses.23:38: Moreover, even these things they did to Me: they defiled My sanctuary and profaned My Sabbaths;
verses.23:39: and when they slew their children to their idols, they also entered into My sanctuary to profane it. And because they did thus in the midst of My house,
verses.23:40: and because for the men who came from afar, to whom they sent messengers, as soon as they came, immediately you washed yourself, and painted your eyes, and adorned yourself with ornaments,
verses.23:41: and you sat upon a spread couch, with a table adorned before it, and they made merry with the incense and My oil,
verses.23:42: and they struck up a sound of harmony, even with men from a multitude of people coming out of the wilderness; and they put bracelets upon their hands and a crown of boasting upon their heads.
verses.23:43: And I said, 'Do they not commit adultery in these things?' And she herself also committed harlotry with the deeds of a harlot;
verses.23:44: and they went in to her; just as men go in to a harlot woman, so they went in to Oholah and to Oholibah to commit iniquity.
verses.23:45: And righteous men, even they shall execute vengeance upon them with the vengeance of an adulteress and with the vengeance of blood, because they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.
verses.23:46: Thus says the Lord, the Lord: 'Bring up a multitude against them, and put tumult and plunder among them,
verses.23:47: and stone them with the stones of multitudes, and pierce them through with their swords; their sons and their daughters they shall slay, and their houses they shall burn.
verses.23:48: And I will turn away impiety from the land, and all the women shall be disciplined, and they shall by no means act according to their impieties.
verses.23:49: And your impiety shall be put upon you, and you shall bear the sins of your devices; and you shall know that I am the Lord.'"
verses.24:1: And the word of the Lord came to me in the ninth year, in the tenth month, on the tenth day of the month, saying,
verses.24:2: "Son of man, write down for yourself for a day, from this day from which the king of Babylon has pressed against Jerusalem, from this very day;
verses.24:3: and speak a parable against the provoking house, and you shall say to them, 'Thus says the Lord: Set on the cauldron and pour water into it,
verses.24:4: and cast into it the cut pieces, every choice piece, leg and shoulder stripped from the bones,
verses.24:5: taken from choice beasts, and kindle the bones underneath them. It has boiled, and its bones have been cooked in its midst.
verses.24:6: Therefore thus says the Lord: O city of blood, a cauldron in which there is rust, and the rust has not gone out of her! Piece by piece she brought it forth; no lot has fallen upon her.
verses.24:7: For her blood is in her midst; upon a bare rock I have set it; I have not poured it upon the ground to cover it with earth,
verses.24:8: that wrath might rise up for vengeance, to be avenged. I have put her blood upon a bare rock, that it should not be covered.
verses.24:9: Therefore thus says the Lord: I also will magnify the people,
verses.24:10: and I will multiply the wood and kindle the fire, so that the flesh may melt away and the broth may be reduced,
verses.24:11: and that she may stand upon the coals, so that her bronze may be scorched and heated, and she may melt in the midst of her uncleanness, and her rust may cease,
verses.24:12: and her abundant rust shall by no means go out of her; her rust shall be put to shame,
verses.24:13: because you have defiled yourself. And what if you are not cleansed any more until I satisfy My wrath?
verses.24:14: I, the Lord, have spoken; it shall come, and I will do it. I will not hold back, nor will I have mercy. According to your ways and according to your devices I will judge you, says the Lord. Therefore I will judge you according to your bloodshed, and according to your devices I will judge you, O unclean one, renowned and abounding in provocation.'"
verses.24:15: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.24:16: "Son of man, behold, I am taking from you the desires of your eyes in battle array; you shall not mourn, nor shall you weep.
verses.24:17: You shall be a groaning of blood, of the loins, of mourning; your hair shall not be braided upon you, and your sandals shall be on your feet; you shall by no means be comforted by their lips, and the bread of men you shall by no means eat."
verses.24:18: And I spoke to the people in the morning in the manner He commanded me in the evening, and I did in the morning in the manner it was enjoined upon me.
verses.24:19: And the people said to me, "Will you not declare to us what these things are that you are doing?"
verses.24:20: And I said to them, "The word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.24:21: 'Say to the house of Israel, Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am profaning My sanctuary, the pride of your strength, the desires of your eyes, and the things that your souls spare. And your sons and your daughters whom you left behind shall fall by the sword,
verses.24:22: and you shall do in the manner I have done: by their mouth you shall not be comforted, and the bread of men you shall not eat;
verses.24:23: and your hair shall be upon your head, and your sandals on your feet; you shall neither mourn nor weep, and you shall waste away in your iniquities, and each one shall comfort his brother.
verses.24:24: And Ezekiel shall be a sign to you; according to all that you have done, you shall do when these things come; and you shall know that I am the Lord.'"
verses.24:25: "And you, son of man, in the day when I take their strength from them, the exaltation of their boasting, the desires of their eyes, and the uplifting of their soul, their sons and their daughters,
verses.24:26: in that day shall not the one who escapes come to you to declare it in your ears?
verses.24:27: In that day your mouth shall be opened to the one who escapes; you shall speak and shall no longer be mute. And you shall be a sign to them, and they shall know that I am the Lord."
verses.25:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.25:2: "Son of man, set your face against the sons of Ammon, and prophesy against them,
verses.25:3: and you shall say to the sons of Ammon, 'Hear the word of the Lord! Thus says the Lord: Because you rejoiced over My sanctuary that it was profaned, and over the land of Israel that it was made desolate, and over the house of Judah that they went into captivity,
verses.25:4: therefore, behold, I am delivering you to the sons of Kedem for an inheritance, and they shall encamp with their furnishings in you and set their dwellings in you; they shall eat your fruits, and they shall drink your fatness.
verses.25:5: And I will make the city of Ammon into pastures for camels, and the sons of Ammon into a pasture for sheep; and you shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.25:6: For thus says the Lord: Because you clapped your hand and stamped with your foot, and rejoiced from your soul over the land of Israel,
verses.25:7: therefore I will stretch out My hand against you and give you for plunder among the nations, and I will utterly destroy you from the peoples, and I will cause you to perish from the lands with destruction; and you shall know that I am the Lord.'"
verses.25:8: Thus says the Lord: "Because Moab has said, 'Behold, are not the house of Israel and Judah like all the nations?'
verses.25:9: therefore, behold, I am loosening the shoulder of Moab from his frontier cities, a choice land, the house of Thasimouth, of the ascent of the city by the sea,
verses.25:10: to the sons of Kedem, together with the sons of Ammon; I have given it to him for an inheritance, so that there may be no remembrance of the sons of Ammon.
verses.25:11: And upon Moab I will execute vengeance, and they shall know that I am the Lord."
verses.25:12: Thus says the Lord: "Because Idumea acted in taking vengeance against the house of Judah, and they bore malice and exacted vengeance,
verses.25:13: therefore thus says the Lord: I will also stretch out My hand against Idumea, and I will utterly destroy man and beast from it, and I will make it desolate; and those pursued from Teman shall fall by the sword.
verses.25:14: And I will lay My vengeance upon Idumea by the hand of My people Israel, and they shall act in Idumea according to My anger and according to My wrath; and they shall know My vengeance," says the Lord.
verses.25:15: Therefore thus says the Lord: "Because the foreigners acted in vengeance and rose up in vengeance, rejoicing from the soul to blot out to the very last one,
verses.25:16: therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I will stretch out My hand against the foreigners, and I will utterly destroy the Cretans, and I will cause the remnant who dwell on the seacoast to perish.
verses.25:17: And I will execute great acts of vengeance among them, and they shall know that I am the Lord, when I lay My vengeance upon them."
verses.26:1: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, on the first day of the month, that the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.26:2: "Son of man, because Tyre has said against Jerusalem, 'Aha! She is shattered! The nations have perished; she has turned to me; she who was full is laid waste!'
verses.26:3: therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I am against you, O Tyre, and I will bring up many nations against you, as the sea comes up with its waves.
verses.26:4: And they shall cast down the walls of Tyre, and cast down your towers; and I will scatter her dust from her, and make her a bare rock.
verses.26:5: She shall be a drying place for nets in the midst of the sea, for I have spoken, says the Lord; and she shall become plunder for the nations.
verses.26:6: And her daughters in the plain shall be slain with the sword; and they shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.26:7: For thus says the Lord: Behold, I am bringing against you, O Tyre, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the north; he is a king of kings, with horses and chariots and horsemen, and an assembly of very many nations.
verses.26:8: He shall slay with the sword your daughters who are in the plain; and he shall set a watchpost against you, and build a siege wall around you, and make a rampart all around against you, and an array of weapons, and he shall set his spears opposite you.
verses.26:9: Your walls and your towers he shall cast down with his swords.
verses.26:10: Because of the multitude of his horses their dust shall cover you; and at the noise of his horsemen and of the wheels of his chariots your walls shall be shaken, as he enters your gates like one entering a city from a plain.
verses.26:11: With the hooves of his horses they shall trample all your streets; your people he shall slay with the sword, and the foundation of your strength he shall bring down to the ground.
verses.26:12: And he shall plunder your wealth, and despoil your possessions; he shall cast down your walls and tear down your desirable houses; and your stones, your timber, and your dust he shall cast into the midst of your sea.
verses.26:13: And he shall put an end to the multitude of your music, and the sound of your harps shall be heard no more.
verses.26:14: And I will make you a bare rock; you shall be a drying place for nets; you shall never be built again, for I, the Lord, have spoken, says the Lord.
verses.26:15: For thus says the Lord, the Lord, to Tyre: Shall not the islands shake at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan, when a sword is drawn in your midst?
verses.26:16: And all the princes from the nations of the sea shall come down from their thrones, and take off the turbans from their heads, and strip off their embroidered garments; they shall be seized with astonishment, they shall sit upon the ground and fear their own destruction, and they shall groan over you.
verses.26:17: And they shall take up a lamentation over you and say to you, 'How have you been destroyed from the sea, O praised city, who put her terror upon all who dwell in her?'
verses.26:18: And the islands shall be afraid from the day of your fall.
verses.26:19: For thus says the Lord, the Lord: When I make you a desolate city, like the cities that shall not be inhabited, when I bring up the deep against you, and much water covers you,
verses.26:20: then I will bring you down to those who go down into the pit, to the people of old, and I will make you dwell in the depths of the earth, like an everlasting desolation, with those who go down into the pit, so that you shall not be inhabited nor rise up upon the land of life.
verses.26:21: I will make you a destruction, and you shall exist no more forever, says the Lord, the Lord."
verses.27:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.27:2: "Son of man, you also take up a lamentation for Tyre,
verses.27:3: and you shall say to Tyre, who dwells at the entrance of the sea, the marketplace of the peoples from many islands, 'Thus says the Lord to Tyre:
verses.27:4: You said, "I have clothed myself with my beauty." In the heart of the sea, for Beelim, your sons clothed you with beauty.
verses.27:5: Cedar from Senir was built for you; strips of cypress planks from Lebanon were taken to make for you masts of fir.
verses.27:6: From Bashan they made your oars; your sanctuaries they made of ivory, wooded houses from the islands of Kittim.
verses.27:7: Fine linen with embroidery from Egypt became your bedding, to clothe you with glory and to wrap you in blue and purple from the islands of Elishah; and they became your coverings.
verses.27:8: And your rulers who dwell in Sidon and the Arvadites became your oarsmen; your wise men, O Tyre, who were in you, these were your pilots.
verses.27:9: The elders of Byblos and their wise men were in you; these strengthened your counsel. And all the ships of the sea and their oarsmen were yours to the west of the west.
verses.27:10: Persians and Lydians and Libyans were in your army; your men of war hung shields and helmets in you; these bestowed your glory.
verses.27:11: The sons of the Arvadites and your army were upon your walls; watchmen were in your towers; they hung their quivers upon your harbors all around; these perfected your beauty.
verses.27:12: The Carthaginians were your merchants because of the abundance of all your strength; silver and gold and iron and tin and lead they gave for your marketplace.
verses.27:13: Greece, both the whole of it and the bordering regions—these traded with you in the souls of men, and vessels of bronze they gave for your merchandise.
verses.27:14: From the house of Togarmah, horses and horsemen supplied your marketplace.
verses.27:15: The sons of the Rhodians were merchants; from the islands they multiplied your merchandise with ivory tusks, and for the wares brought in you gave back your wages.
verses.27:16: Men were your merchandise because of the abundance of your mixed wares, oil of myrrh and embroidered work from Tarshish; and Lamoth and Chorchor supplied your marketplace.
verses.27:17: Judah and the children of Israel, these were your merchants in the sale of grain and ointments and cassia; and the choicest honey and oil and resin they gave for your mixed wares.
verses.27:18: Damascus was your merchant because of the abundance of all your wealth; wine from Helbon and wool from Miletus, and wine they gave to your marketplace.
verses.27:19: From Asel is wrought iron, and wheelwork is among your mixed wares.
verses.27:20: Dedan was your merchant with choice beasts for chariots.
verses.27:21: Arabia and all the princes of Kedar, these were your merchants through your hand, with camels and rams and lambs, in which they trade with you.
verses.27:22: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah, these were your merchants with the finest spices and precious stones; and gold they gave for your marketplace.
verses.27:23: Haran and Canneh, these were your merchants.
verses.27:24: Asshur and Charman were your merchants, bringing merchandise of blue and choice treasures bound with cords, and wares of cypress wood.
verses.27:25: Ships were your merchants in your abundance, in your mixed wares; and you were filled and became exceedingly heavy in the heart of the sea.
verses.27:26: Into much water your oarsmen brought you; the south wind shattered you in the heart of the sea.
verses.27:27: There were your riches, and your wages and those of your traders, and your oarsmen and your pilots and your counselors, and your traders from among your mixed wares, and all your men of war who are in you; and all your assembly in the midst of you shall fall into the heart of the sea in the day of your fall.
verses.27:28: At the cry of your voice your pilots shall fear with great fear,
verses.27:29: and all the oarsmen and the passengers shall come down from the ships, and the lookouts of the sea shall stand upon the land,
verses.27:30: and they shall wail over you with their voice and cry out bitterly; and they shall cast earth upon their heads and spread ashes under themselves.
verses.27:32: And their sons shall take up a lamentation over you, a dirge for Tyre:
verses.27:33: How great a wage did you find from the sea? You filled nations from your abundance, and from your mixed wares you enriched all the kings of the earth.
verses.27:34: Now you have been shattered in the sea; in the depth of the water are your mixed wares and all your assembly in the midst of you; all your oarsmen have fallen.
verses.27:35: All who dwell in the islands were appalled at you, and their kings were astounded with great astonishment, and their countenance wept.
verses.27:36: Merchants from among the nations hissed at you; you have become a ruin, and you shall be no more forever.'"
verses.28:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.28:2: "And you, son of man, say to the prince of Tyre, 'Thus says the Lord: Because your heart was lifted up, and you said, "I am a god; I have dwelt in the habitation of God in the heart of the sea," yet you are a man and not a god, and you set your heart as the heart of a god—
verses.28:3: are you wiser than Daniel? Did not wise men instruct you in their knowledge?
verses.28:4: Was it by your knowledge or by your understanding that you made for yourself power, and gold and silver in your treasuries?
verses.28:5: By your great knowledge and trade you multiplied your power; your heart was lifted up in your power.
verses.28:6: Therefore thus says the Lord: Because you have set your heart as the heart of a god,
verses.28:7: for this reason, behold, I am bringing upon you strangers, pestilent men from the nations; and they shall draw their swords against you and against the beauty of your knowledge, and they shall lay your beauty low to destruction,
verses.28:8: and they shall bring you down, and you shall die the death of the slain in the heart of the sea.
verses.28:9: Will you indeed say, "I am a god," before those who slay you? Yet you are a man and not a god.
verses.28:10: Among a multitude of the uncircumcised you shall perish by the hands of strangers; for I have spoken, says the Lord.'"
verses.28:11: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.28:12: "Son of man, take up a lamentation over the prince of Tyre, and say to him, 'Thus says the Lord, the Lord: You were a seal of likeness
verses.28:13: and a crown of beauty in the delight of the paradise of God. With every precious stone you were bound: sardius and topaz and emerald, and carbuncle and sapphire and jasper, and silver and gold, and ligure and agate and amethyst, and chrysolite and beryl and onyx; and with gold you filled your treasuries and your storehouses within you.
verses.28:14: From the day you were created with the cherub, I placed you on the holy mountain of God; you were in the midst of fiery stones.
verses.28:15: You were blameless in your days, from the day you were created until iniquities were found in you.
verses.28:16: By the abundance of your trade you filled your storechambers with lawlessness, and you sinned, and you were wounded from the mountain of God; and the cherub led you out from the midst of the fiery stones.
verses.28:17: Your heart was lifted up because of your beauty; your knowledge was corrupted along with your beauty. Because of the multitude of your sins I cast you to the ground; before kings I gave you over to be made a public example.
verses.28:18: Because of the multitude of your sins and the iniquities of your trade, I profaned your sanctuaries, and I will bring forth fire from the midst of you; this shall devour you, and I will turn you into ashes upon your earth before all who see you.
verses.28:19: And all who know you among the nations shall groan over you; you have become a ruin, and you shall exist no more forever.'"
verses.28:20: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.28:21: "Son of man, set your face against Sidon, and prophesy against her,
verses.28:22: and say, 'Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am against you, O Sidon, and I will be glorified in you; and you shall know that I am the Lord when I execute judgments in you, and I will be sanctified in you.
verses.28:23: Blood and death shall be in your streets, and those slain by swords shall fall within you all around you; and they shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.28:24: And there shall no longer be in the house of Israel a briar of bitterness and a thorn of pain from those all around them who dishonored them; and they shall know that I am the Lord.'"
verses.28:25: Thus says the Lord, the Lord: "I will also gather Israel from the nations where they were scattered, and I will be sanctified in them and before the peoples and the nations.
verses.28:26: And they shall dwell upon their own land, which I have given to My servant Jacob, and they shall dwell upon it in hope; and they shall build houses and plant vineyards, and they shall dwell in hope when I execute judgment upon all those who dishonored them among those all around them; and they shall know that I am the Lord their God, and the God of their fathers."
verses.29:1: In the twelfth year, in the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.29:2: "Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him and against all Egypt,
verses.29:3: and say, 'Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am against Pharaoh, the great dragon who lies in the midst of his rivers, who says, "The rivers are mine, and I myself made them."
verses.29:4: And I will put snares into your jaws, and I will cause the fish of your river to cling to your fins, and I will bring you up out of the midst of your river,
verses.29:5: and I will cast you down swiftly, together with all the fish of your river. You shall fall upon the face of the plain, and you shall by no means be gathered nor buried; to the beasts of the earth and to the birds of heaven I have given you for food.
verses.29:6: Then all who dwell in Egypt shall know that I am the Lord, because you have become a staff of reed to the house of Israel.
verses.29:7: When they took hold of you with their hand, you were crushed; and when every hand clapped against them, and when they leaned upon you, you were shattered, and you broke all their loins.
verses.29:8: Therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I am bringing a sword upon you, and I will destroy men and beasts from among you,
verses.29:9: and the land of Egypt shall become ruin and desolation; and they shall know that I am the Lord, because you say, "The rivers are mine, and I myself made them."
verses.29:10: Therefore, behold, I am against you and against all your rivers, and I will give the land of Egypt over to desolation, the sword, and ruin, from Migdol and Syene even to the borders of the Ethiopians.
verses.29:11: No foot of man shall pass through it, nor shall any foot of beast pass through it, and it shall not be inhabited for forty years.
verses.29:12: And I will make her land a ruin in the midst of a desolated land, and her cities in the midst of desolated cities shall be forty years; and I will scatter Egypt among the nations, and winnow them into the countries.
verses.29:13: Thus says the Lord: After forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the nations where they were dispersed,
verses.29:14: and I will restore the captivity of the Egyptians, and cause them to dwell in the land of Pathros, in the land from which they were taken; and it shall be a lowly dominion
verses.29:15: beyond all dominions, and it shall never again be exalted above the nations; and I will make them few in number, so that they shall not be more numerous among the nations.
verses.29:16: And they shall no longer be a hope for the house of Israel, bringing iniquity to remembrance when they follow after them; and they shall know that I am the Lord.'"
verses.29:17: And it came to pass in the twenty-seventh year, on the first day of the first month, that the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.29:18: "Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon made his army serve a heavy service against Tyre; every head was made bald, and every shoulder was rubbed bare; yet neither he nor his army received wages from Tyre, nor for the service which they served against her.
verses.29:19: Thus says the Sovereign Lord: Behold, I am giving the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he shall plunder her plunder and despoil her spoil, and it shall be wages for his army.
verses.29:20: In return for his labor which he served against Tyre, I have given him the land of Egypt. Thus says the Sovereign Lord:
verses.29:21: In that day a horn shall spring forth for all the house of Israel, and to you I will give an open mouth in their midst, and they shall know that I am the Lord."
verses.30:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.30:2: "Son of man, prophesy and say, 'Thus says the Lord: Woe, woe for the day!
verses.30:3: For the day is near, the day of the Lord; it shall be the end of the nations.
verses.30:4: And a sword shall come upon the Egyptians, and there shall be turmoil in the land of Ethiopia; and the slain shall fall together in Egypt, and her foundations shall fall down together.
verses.30:5: Persians and Cretans and Lydians and Libyans, and all the mixed multitude, and some of the sons of My covenant shall fall by the sword in her.
verses.30:6: And the supports of Egypt shall fall, and the pride of her strength shall come down from Migdol to Syene; by the sword they shall fall in her, says the Lord.
verses.30:7: And it shall be desolated in the midst of desolated countries, and their cities shall be in the midst of desolated cities;
verses.30:8: and they shall know that I am the Lord, when I set fire upon Egypt and all who help her are shattered.
verses.30:9: In that day messengers shall go forth hastening to destroy Ethiopia, and there shall be turmoil among them in the day of Egypt; for behold, it is coming.
verses.30:10: Thus says the Sovereign Lord: I will also destroy the multitude of the Egyptians by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon,
verses.30:11: of him and his people—pestilent men from the nations sent to destroy the land; and they shall all unsheathe their swords against Egypt, and the land shall be filled with the slain.
verses.30:12: And I will make their rivers desolate, and I will destroy the land and its fullness by the hands of strangers; I, the Lord, have spoken.
verses.30:13: For thus says the Sovereign Lord: I will also destroy the nobles from Memphis and the rulers of Memphis from the land of Egypt, and they shall be no more.
verses.30:14: And I will destroy the land of Pathros, and set fire upon Tanis, and execute vengeance in Diospolis.
verses.30:15: And I will pour out My fury upon Sais, the strength of Egypt, and I will destroy the multitude of Memphis.
verses.30:16: And I will set fire upon Egypt, and Syene shall be thrown into utter turmoil; and in Diospolis there shall be a breach, and waters shall be poured out.
verses.30:17: The young men of Heliopolis and Bubastis shall fall by the sword, and the women shall go into captivity;
verses.30:18: and in Tahpanhes the day shall grow dark when I break there the scepters of Egypt, and the pride of her strength shall perish there; a cloud shall cover her, and her daughters shall be led away captive.
verses.30:19: Thus I will execute judgment in Egypt, and they shall know that I am the Lord.'"
verses.30:20: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first month, on the seventh day of the month, that the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.30:21: "Son of man, I have broken the arms of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and behold, they have not been bound up to be given healing, to have a poultice placed upon him, to be given strength to grasp a sword.
verses.30:22: Therefore thus says the Sovereign Lord: Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and I will break his arms, both the strong and the outstretched, and I will strike down his sword out of his hand;
verses.30:23: and I will scatter Egypt among the nations and winnow them into the countries,
verses.30:24: and I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon and put My sword into his hand, and he shall bring it upon Egypt and plunder her plunder and despoil her spoil.
verses.30:25: And I will fortify the arms of the king of Babylon, while the arms of Pharaoh shall fall; and they shall know that I am the Lord when I put My sword into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he shall stretch it out over the land of Egypt.
verses.30:26: And I will scatter Egypt among the nations, and winnow them into the countries; and all shall know that I am the Lord."
verses.31:1: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the third month, on the first day of the month, that the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.31:2: "Son of man, say to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his multitude, 'To whom have you likened yourself in your loftiness?
verses.31:3: Behold, Asshur was a cypress in Lebanon, fair in his shoots and lofty in stature, and his top reached into the midst of the clouds.
verses.31:4: Water nourished him, the deep exalted him; she led her rivers all around his plants, and sent forth her channels to all the trees of the plain.
verses.31:5: Because of this, his stature was exalted above all the trees of the plain, and his boughs spread wide because of abundant water.
verses.31:6: In his shoots all the birds of heaven made their nests, and beneath his boughs all the beasts of the plain brought forth their young; in his shadow dwelt every multitude of nations.
verses.31:7: And he became fair in his loftiness because of the multitude of his boughs, for his roots reached into abundant water.
verses.31:8: And such cypresses were in the paradise of God; yet the pine trees were not like his shoots, and the fir trees were not like his boughs; no tree in the paradise of God was comparable to him in his beauty
verses.31:9: because of the multitude of his boughs; and the trees of the paradise of the delight of God envied him.
verses.31:10: Therefore thus says the Lord: Because you became great in stature and set your top into the midst of the clouds, and I saw when he was exalted,
verses.31:11: I also delivered him into the hands of a ruler of nations, and he executed his destruction;
verses.31:12: and pestilent strangers from the nations utterly destroyed him and cast him down upon the mountains; in all the valleys his boughs fell, and his branches were broken in every plain of the earth, and all the peoples of the nations came down from their shelter and dashed him to the ground.
verses.31:13: Upon his ruin all the birds of heaven rested, and upon his branches were all the beasts of the field,
verses.31:14: so that all the trees that are in the water might not be exalted in their stature; yet they set their top into the midst of the clouds, and they did not stand in their loftiness toward them; all who drink water—all have been given over to death, to the depth of the earth, in the midst of the sons of men, to those who go down to the pit.
verses.31:15: Thus says the Sovereign Lord: In the day he went down into Hades, the deep mourned for him, and I halted her rivers and restrained the abundance of water; and Lebanon grew dark over him, and all the trees of the plain fainted over him.
verses.31:16: At the sound of his fall the nations were shaken, when I brought him down into Hades with those who go down into the pit; and all the trees of delight and the choice trees of Lebanon, all that drink water, comforted him in the earth.
verses.31:17: For they also went down with him into Hades among those slain by the sword; and his seed, those who dwelt beneath his shelter, perished in the midst of their life.
verses.31:18: To whom have you been likened? Go down and be brought down with the trees of delight into the depth of the earth; in the midst of the uncircumcised you shall lie down with those slain by the sword. Thus shall it be with Pharaoh and the multitude of his strength, says the Sovereign Lord.'"
verses.32:1: And it came to pass in the twelfth year, in the tenth month, on the first day of the month, that the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.32:2: "Son of man, take up a lamentation over Pharaoh king of Egypt, and you shall say to him, 'You have been likened to a lion of the nations, and like the dragon in the sea; you butted in your rivers, and troubled the water with your feet, and trampled your rivers.
verses.32:3: Thus says the Lord: And I will cast over you the nets of many peoples, and I will draw you up with My hook,
verses.32:4: and I will stretch you out upon the earth; the plains shall be filled with you, and I will cause all the birds to settle upon you, and I will satisfy all the beasts of all the earth;
verses.32:5: and I will lay your flesh upon the mountains, and I will fill them with your blood;
verses.32:6: and the earth shall be watered from your outpourings, from your multitude upon the mountains; I will fill the ravines from you.
verses.32:7: And when you are extinguished, I will cover heaven and darken its stars; the sun I will cover with a cloud, and the moon shall by no means shine its light.
verses.32:8: All the shining lights in heaven shall grow dark over you, and I will set darkness upon the land, says the Lord, the Lord.
verses.32:9: And I will provoke to anger the heart of many peoples when I lead your captivity into the nations, into a land which you did not know.
verses.32:10: And many nations shall be appalled over you, and their kings shall be astounded with astonishment when My sword flies before their faces, awaiting their own downfall from the day of your downfall.
verses.32:11: For thus says the Lord: The sword of the king of Babylon shall come upon you
verses.32:12: with the swords of giants, and I will cast down your strength; all of them are pestilent ones from the nations, and they shall destroy the arrogance of Egypt, and all her strength shall be crushed.
verses.32:13: And I will destroy all her cattle from beside abundant water, and the foot of man shall no longer trouble it, and the tread of cattle shall by no means trample it.
verses.32:14: So then shall their waters become still, and their rivers shall flow like oil, says the Lord.
verses.32:15: When I give Egypt over to destruction, and the land is made desolate together with its fullness, when I scatter all who dwell in it, then they shall know that I am the Lord.'
verses.32:16: It is a lamentation, and you shall lament it, and the daughters of the nations shall lament it; over Egypt and over all her strength they shall lament her, says the Lord, the Lord."
verses.32:17: And it came to pass in the twelfth year, in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the month, that the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.32:18: "Son of man, lament over the strength of Egypt; and the nations shall bring down her daughters dead into the depth of the earth, to those who go down into the pit.
verses.32:20: In the midst of those slain by the sword they shall fall with him, and all his strength shall lie down.
verses.32:21: And the giants shall say to you, 'Be in the depth of tumult! Whom do you surpass? Go down and lie with the uncircumcised in the midst of those slain by the sword.'
verses.32:22: There is Assyria and all its assembly; all the slain were placed there, and their burial is in the depth of the pit, and its assembly was placed all around its tomb, all the slain who fell by the sword,
verses.32:23: who caused their terror upon the land of life.
verses.32:24: There is Elam and all its host all around its tomb, all the slain who fell by the sword and who go down uncircumcised into the depth of the earth, who caused their terror in life; and they received their torment with those who go down into the pit
verses.32:25: in the midst of the slain.
verses.32:26: There were placed Meshech and Tubal and all their strength all around his tomb, all his slain, all uncircumcised, slain by the sword, who caused their terror in life;
verses.32:27: and they lay down with the giants who fell from of old, who went down into Hades in weapons of war and laid their swords beneath their heads; and their iniquities came upon their bones, because they terrified all in their life.
verses.32:28: And you shall lie down in the midst of the uncircumcised, with those who have been slain by the sword.
verses.32:29: There were placed the rulers of Assyria, who gave its strength to the wound of the sword; these lay down with the slain, with those who go down into the pit.
verses.32:30: There are the rulers of the north, all the commanders of Assyria, who go down slain; together with their terror and their strength they lay down uncircumcised with those slain by the sword, and they bore their torment with those who go down into the pit.
verses.32:31: King Pharaoh shall see them, and he shall be comforted over all their strength, says the Lord, the Lord.
verses.32:32: For I have set his terror in life, and he shall lie down in the midst of the uncircumcised with those slain by the sword, Pharaoh and all his multitude with him, says the Lord, the Lord."
verses.33:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.33:2: "Son of man, speak to the sons of your people and you shall say to them, 'A land upon which I bring a sword, and the people of the land take one man from among them and appoint him for themselves as a watchman,
verses.33:3: and he sees the sword coming upon the land, and blows the trumpet and gives warning to the people,
verses.33:4: and anyone who indeed hears the sound of the trumpet and does not take heed, and the sword comes and overtakes him, his blood shall be upon his head.
verses.33:5: Because having heard the sound of the trumpet he did not take heed, his blood shall be upon himself; yet this one, because he took heed, has delivered his own soul.
verses.33:6: But if the watchman sees the sword coming and does not signal with the trumpet, and the people are not warned, and the sword comes and takes a soul from among them, that soul was taken because of its own iniquity, yet the blood I will require from the hand of the watchman.'
verses.33:7: And as for you, son of man, I have appointed you a watchman for the house of Israel; and you shall hear a word from My mouth.
verses.33:8: When I say to the sinner, 'You shall surely die,' and you do not speak to warn the ungodly man from his way, that lawless man shall die in his iniquity, but his blood I will require from your hand.
verses.33:9: Yet if you forewarn the ungodly man concerning his way, to turn back from it, and he does not turn back from his way, he shall die in his ungodliness, but you have delivered your own soul.
verses.33:10: And you, son of man, say to the house of Israel, 'Thus you have spoken, saying: Our errors and our iniquities are upon us, and in them we waste away; how then shall we live?'
verses.33:11: Say to them, 'As I live, thus says the Lord, I do not desire the death of the ungodly, as much as that the ungodly turn back from his way and live. Turn back completely from your way; and why do you die, O house of Israel?'
verses.33:12: Say to the sons of your people, 'The righteousness of the righteous shall by no means deliver him in the day in which he goes astray, and the iniquity of the ungodly shall by no means harm him in the day in which he turns back from his iniquity; and a righteous man shall by no means be able to be saved.
verses.33:13: When I say to the righteous man: This man has trusted in his righteousness—and he commits iniquity—none of his righteous deeds shall be remembered; in his unrighteousness which he has committed, in it he shall die.
verses.33:14: And when I say to the ungodly man: You shall surely die—and he turns back from his sin, and executes judgment and righteousness,
verses.33:15: and restores a pledge and repays what he seized by robbery, and walks in the statutes of life so as to commit no unrighteousness, he shall surely live and shall by no means die;
verses.33:16: none of his sins which he has sinned shall be remembered; because he has executed judgment and righteousness, by them he shall live.'
verses.33:17: Yet the sons of your people shall say, 'The way of the Lord is not straight.' Yet it is their own way that is not straight.
verses.33:18: When a righteous man turns back from his righteousness and commits iniquities, then he shall die in them.
verses.33:19: And when the sinner turns back from his iniquity and executes judgment and righteousness, by them he himself shall live.
verses.33:20: And this is what you have said, 'The way of the Lord is not straight.' Each one according to his ways I will judge you, O house of Israel."
verses.33:21: And it came to pass in the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, on the fifth day of the month, of our captivity, that the one who had escaped came to me from Jerusalem, saying, "The city has been captured."
verses.33:22: And the hand of the Lord came upon me in the evening before he arrived, and He opened my mouth until he came to me in the morning; and once my mouth was opened, it was closed no more.
verses.33:23: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.33:24: "Son of man, those who dwell in the desolate places in the land of Israel are saying, 'Abraham was one, and he possessed the land, yet we are many; to us the land has been given for a possession.'
verses.33:25: Therefore say to them, 'Thus says the Lord, the Lord:
verses.33:27: As I live, surely those in the desolate places shall fall by swords, and those on the face of the plain shall be given to the beasts of the field for food, and those in the walled places and those in the caves I will slay with death.
verses.33:28: And I will make the land a desolation, and the arrogance of her strength shall perish; and the mountains of Israel shall be made desolate because there is no one passing through.
verses.33:29: And they shall know that I am the Lord; and I will make their land a desolation, and it shall be laid waste because of all their abominations which they have committed.'
verses.33:30: And you, son of man—as for the sons of your people who speak about you beside the walls and in the doorways of the houses, they speak one to his brother, saying, 'Let us come together and hear what goes forth from the Lord.'
verses.33:31: They come to you as a people assembles, and they sit before you and hear your words, yet they will by no means do them; for falsehood is in their mouth, and their heart goes after defilements.
verses.33:32: And you become to them like the sound of a sweet-toned, well-tuned harp; and they shall hear your words, yet they shall by no means do them.
verses.33:33: And when it comes to pass, they shall say, 'Behold, it has come!' And they shall know that a prophet was in their midst."
verses.34:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.34:2: "Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel; prophesy and say to the shepherds, 'Thus says the Sovereign Lord: O shepherds of Israel, do shepherds feed themselves? Do not shepherds feed the sheep?
verses.34:3: Behold, you consume the milk and clothe yourselves with the wool, and you slaughter the fatling, but you do not feed My sheep.
verses.34:4: You did not strengthen the weak, and you did not restore the sick to health; you did not bind up the broken, and you did not bring back the straying; you did not seek the lost, and you wore down the strong with toil.
verses.34:5: And My sheep were scattered because there were no shepherds, and they became food for all the wild beasts of the field.
verses.34:6: And My sheep were scattered on every mountain and upon every high hill; and over the face of the earth they were scattered, and there was no one seeking them out, nor anyone bringing them back.
verses.34:7: Therefore, shepherds, hear the word of the Lord:
verses.34:8: As I live, says the Sovereign Lord, surely because My sheep became plunder, and My sheep became food for all the wild beasts of the plain because there were no shepherds, and the shepherds did not seek out My sheep, but the shepherds fed themselves and did not feed My sheep,
verses.34:10: thus says the Sovereign Lord: Behold, I am against the shepherds, and I will require My sheep from their hands, and I will turn them away from shepherding My sheep, and the shepherds shall feed them no more; and I will deliver My sheep from their mouth, and they shall no longer be food for them.
verses.34:11: For thus says the Lord: Behold, I Myself will seek out My sheep and watch over them.
verses.34:12: Just as a shepherd seeks his flock on a day when there is gloom and cloud in the midst of separated sheep, so I will seek out My sheep and bring them out from every place where they were scattered on a day of cloud and gloom.
verses.34:13: And I will bring them out from the nations and gather them from the countries, and I will bring them into their own land; and I will feed them upon the mountains of Israel, and in the valleys, and in every dwelling place of the land.
verses.34:14: In good pasture I will feed them, on the high mountain of Israel. And their sheepfolds shall be there, and they shall lie down, and there they shall rest in good abundance, and in rich pasture they shall graze upon the mountains of Israel.
verses.34:15: I Myself will feed My sheep, and I Myself will give them rest, and they shall know that I am the Lord. Thus says the Sovereign Lord:
verses.34:16: I will seek the lost, and I will bring back the straying, and I will bind up the broken, and I will strengthen the failing, and I will guard the strong, and I will feed them with judgment.
verses.34:17: And as for you, O sheep, thus says the Sovereign Lord: Behold, I will judge between sheep and sheep, rams and male goats.
verses.34:18: And is it not enough for you that you grazed in the good pasture, and trampled down the remainder of your pasture with your feet? And that you drank the settled water, and troubled the rest with your feet?
verses.34:19: And did My sheep graze on what was trampled by your feet, and drink the water troubled by your feet?
verses.34:20: Therefore thus says the Sovereign Lord: Behold, I will judge between the strong sheep and the weak sheep.
verses.34:21: With your sides and your shoulders you pushed, and with your horns you butted, and every failing one you pressed out.
verses.34:22: And I will save My sheep, and they shall no longer be plunder; and I will judge between ram and ram.
verses.34:23: And I will raise up over them one shepherd, and he shall shepherd them—My servant David—and he shall be their shepherd.
verses.34:24: And I, the Lord, will be God to them, and David shall be prince in their midst; I, the Lord, have spoken.
verses.34:25: And I will make a covenant of peace with David, and I will remove evil wild beasts from the land; and they shall dwell in the wilderness and sleep in the forests.
verses.34:26: And I will set them around My mountain; and I will give you the rain, a rain of blessing.
verses.34:27: And the trees of the plain shall yield their fruit, and the earth shall yield its strength, and they shall dwell upon their land in hope of peace; and they shall know that I am the Lord when I break their yoke, and I will deliver them from the hand of those who enslaved them,
verses.34:28: and they shall no longer be plunder for the nations, and the wild beasts of the earth shall never again devour them; and they shall dwell in hope, and there shall be no one to terrify them.
verses.34:29: And I will raise up for them a plant of peace, and they shall no longer perish by famine in the land, and they shall never again bear the reproach of the nations.
verses.34:30: And they shall know that I am the Lord their God, and they are My people. O house of Israel, says the Lord,
verses.34:31: you are My sheep and the sheep of My flock, and I am the Lord your God, says the Sovereign Lord.'"
verses.35:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.35:2: "Son of man, turn your face toward Mount Seir and prophesy against it,
verses.35:3: and say, 'Thus says the Sovereign Lord: Behold, I am against you, O Mount Seir, and I will stretch out My hand against you, and I will make you a desolation, and you shall be laid waste,
verses.35:4: and I will bring desolation upon your cities, and you shall be desolate; and you shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.35:5: Because you became an everlasting enemy, and you lay in ambush for the house of Israel with deceit, by the hand of enemies with the sword, in the time of iniquity at the end,
verses.35:6: therefore, as I live, says the Sovereign Lord, surely you have sinned even to blood, and blood shall pursue you.
verses.35:7: And I will make Mount Seir a desolation and a waste, and I will destroy from it men and beasts,
verses.35:8: and I will fill the hills and your valleys with the slain, and in all your plains those slain by the sword shall fall in you.
verses.35:9: I will make you an everlasting desolation, and your cities shall never again be inhabited; and you shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.35:10: Because you said, "The two nations and the two countries shall be mine, and I will inherit them," yet the Lord is there.
verses.35:11: Therefore, as I live, says the Lord, I will deal with you according to your enmity, and I will make Myself known to you when I judge you,
verses.35:12: and you shall know that I am the Lord. I have heard the voice of your blasphemies, that you said, "The mountains of Israel are desolate; they have been given to us for food,"
verses.35:13: and you spoke boastfully against Me with your mouth; I Myself have heard.
verses.35:14: Thus says the Lord: In the gladness of all the earth I will make you desolate;
verses.35:15: you shall be desolate, O Mount Seir, and all Idumea, and it shall be utterly consumed; you shall know that I am the Lord their God.'"
verses.36:1: "And you, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel, and say to the mountains of Israel, 'Hear the word of the Lord:
verses.36:2: Thus says the Sovereign Lord: Because the enemy has said against you, "Aha! Eternal wastes have become a possession for us,"'
verses.36:3: therefore prophesy and say, 'Thus says the Sovereign Lord: Because you were dishonored and hated by those around you, so that you became a possession for the rest of the nations, and you came up as talk upon the tongue and as a reproach to the nations;
verses.36:4: therefore, O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord: Thus says the Lord to the mountains and to the hills, and to the ravines and to the brooks, and to the desolate and ruined places, and to the forsaken cities, and they have become a plunder and a trampling ground to the remaining nations all around;
verses.36:5: therefore thus says the Sovereign Lord: Surely in the fire of My wrath I have spoken against the rest of the nations and against all Idumea, because they gave My land to themselves as a possession with gladness, dishonoring souls so as to lay it waste in plunder.'
verses.36:6: Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel, and say to the mountains and to the hills, and to the ravines and to the valleys, 'Thus says the Lord: Behold, I have spoken in My jealousy and in My wrath, because you have borne the reproaches of the nations.
verses.36:7: Therefore I will lift up My hand against the nations that are all around you; they themselves shall bear their dishonor.
verses.36:8: But as for you, O mountains of Israel, My people shall eat your grapes and your fruit, for they are hoping to come.
verses.36:9: For behold, I am for you, and I will look upon you, and you shall be tilled and sown;
verses.36:10: and I will multiply men upon you, all the house of Israel completely; and the cities shall be inhabited, and the desolate place shall be built.
verses.36:11: And I will multiply upon you men and beasts, and I will cause you to be inhabited as in your beginning, and I will do good to you just as in your former times; and you shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.36:12: And I will bring forth men upon you, My people Israel, and they shall inherit you, and you shall be a possession for them; and you shall never again be bereaved of them.
verses.36:13: Thus says the Sovereign Lord: Because they have said to you, "You are a devourer of men, and you have been made childless by your nation,"
verses.36:14: therefore you shall devour men no longer, and you shall no longer bereave your nation, says the Sovereign Lord.
verses.36:15: And the dishonor of the nations shall no longer be heard against you, and you shall by no means bear the reproaches of peoples, says the Sovereign Lord.'"
verses.36:16: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.36:17: "Son of man, the house of Israel dwelt upon their own land, and they defiled it by their way, and by their idols, and by their uncleannesses; and their way before My face became like the uncleanness of a woman in her impurity.
verses.36:18: And I poured out My wrath upon them,
verses.36:19: and I scattered them among the nations, and I winnowed them into the countries; according to their way and according to their sin I judged them.
verses.36:20: And they went into the nations wherever they went, and they profaned My holy name, in that it was said of them, 'These are the people of the Lord, and they have gone out from His land.'
verses.36:21: And I spared them for the sake of My holy name, which the house of Israel profaned among the nations where they went.
verses.36:22: Therefore say to the house of Israel, 'Thus says the Lord: I do not do this for you, O house of Israel, but rather for the sake of My holy name, which you profaned among the nations where you went.
verses.36:23: And I will sanctify My great name, which was profaned among the nations, which you profaned in their midst; and the nations shall know that I am the Lord, when I am sanctified in you before their eyes.
verses.36:24: And I will take you out of the nations, and gather you out of all the lands, and bring you into your own land.
verses.36:25: And I will sprinkle clean water upon you, and you shall be cleansed from all your uncleannesses and from all your idols, and I will cleanse you;
verses.36:26: and I will give to you a new heart, and a new spirit I will put within you; and I will remove the stony heart from your flesh, and I will give to you a heart of flesh.
verses.36:27: And I will put My Spirit within you, and cause you to walk in My ordinances, and to guard My judgments and perform them.
verses.36:28: And you shall dwell in the land which I gave to your fathers; and you shall be to Me a people, and I will be to you God.
verses.36:29: And I will save you from all your uncleannesses; and I will summon the grain and multiply it, and I will bring no famine upon you.
verses.36:30: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree and the produce of the field, so that you may not receive the reproach of famine among the nations.
verses.36:31: And you shall remember your evil ways and your practices that were not good; and you shall be filled with loathing before them in your iniquities and for their abominations.
verses.36:32: Not for your sake am I acting, says the Sovereign Lord; it is known to you. Be ashamed and confounded because of your ways, O house of Israel.
verses.36:33: Thus says Adonai, the Lord: In the day when I cleanse you from all your iniquities, I will also cause the cities to be inhabited, and the desolate places shall be built.
verses.36:34: And the desolate land shall be tilled, whereas it had become desolate before the eyes of every passerby.
verses.36:35: And they shall say, "That desolate land has become like a garden of delight, and the waste, desolate, and overturned cities have been fortified and inhabited."
verses.36:36: And the nations, as many as are left remaining around you, shall know that I, the Lord, have rebuilt the demolished places and planted the desolate places; I, the Lord, have spoken, and I will do it.
verses.36:37: Thus says Adonai, the Lord: Yet for this I will be inquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them: I will multiply them like sheep, even men,
verses.36:38: like holy sheep, like the sheep of Jerusalem in her feasts; so shall the desolate cities be full of flocks of men, and they shall know that I am the Lord.'"
verses.37:1: And the hand of the Lord came upon me, and the Lord brought me out in the Spirit and set me down in the midst of the plain; and it was full of human bones.
verses.37:2: And He led me around them all about on every side; and behold, there were very many upon the face of the plain, very dry.
verses.37:3: And He said to me, "Son of man, shall these bones live?" And I said, "Lord, You know these things."
verses.37:4: And He said to me, "Prophesy over these bones, and you shall say to them, 'O dry bones, hear the word of the Lord:
verses.37:5: Thus says the Lord to these bones: Behold, I am bringing into you a spirit of life,
verses.37:6: and I will lay sinews upon you, and bring flesh upon you, and stretch skin over you, and put My Spirit into you, and you shall live; and you shall know that I am the Lord.'"
verses.37:7: And I prophesied as He commanded me. And it came to pass, as I prophesied, behold, there was a shaking, and the bones drew near, each one to its joint.
verses.37:8: And I looked, and behold, sinews and flesh grew upon them, and skin came up over them above; yet there was no spirit in them.
verses.37:9: And He said to me, "Prophesy to the spirit, prophesy, son of man, and say to the spirit, 'Thus says the Lord: Come from the four winds, and breathe into these dead ones, and let them live.'"
verses.37:10: And I prophesied just as He commanded me; and the spirit entered into them, and they lived, and they stood upon their feet, an exceedingly great assembly.
verses.37:11: And the Lord spoke to me, saying, "Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel; and they say, 'Our bones have become dry, our hope has perished, we are utterly lost.'
verses.37:12: Therefore prophesy and say, 'Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am opening your tombs, and I will bring you up out of your tombs, and I will bring you into the land of Israel;
verses.37:13: and you shall know that I am the Lord, when I open your graves, to bring up My people out of the graves.
verses.37:14: And I will put My Spirit into you, and you shall live, and I will place you upon your own land; and you shall know that I, the Lord, have spoken and will perform it, says the Lord.'"
verses.37:15: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.37:16: "Son of man, take for yourself a rod, and write upon it Judah and the sons of Israel who are joined to him; and you shall take for yourself a second rod, and write upon it, 'For Joseph, the rod of Ephraim, and all the sons of Israel who are added to him.'
verses.37:17: And you shall join them one to another for yourself into one rod, to bind them together, and they shall be in your hand.
verses.37:18: And it shall come to pass, when the sons of your people say to you, 'Will you not declare to us what these things mean to you?'
verses.37:19: then you shall say to them, 'Thus says the Lord: Behold, I will take the tribe of Joseph, which is by the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel joined to him, and I will place them upon the tribe of Judah, and they shall become one rod in the hand of Judah.'
verses.37:20: And the rods upon which you wrote shall be in your hand before them,
verses.37:21: and you shall say to them, 'Thus says the Sovereign Lord: Behold, I am taking all the house of Israel from the midst of the nations where they went, and I will gather them from all who are around them, and I will bring them into the land of Israel;
verses.37:22: and I will make them into a nation in My land and upon the mountains of Israel; and one ruler shall be over them, and they shall no longer be two nations, nor shall they ever again be divided into two kingdoms,
verses.37:23: so that they may no longer be defiled with their idols. And I will deliver them from all their iniquities by which they sinned, and I will cleanse them; and they shall be to Me a people, and I, the Lord, will be to them God.
verses.37:24: And My servant David shall be ruler in their midst; there shall be one shepherd of them all, for they shall walk in My statutes, and they shall keep My judgments and perform them.
verses.37:25: And they shall dwell upon their land which I have given to My servant Jacob, where their fathers dwelt; and they themselves shall dwell upon it. And David My servant shall be ruler forever.
verses.37:26: And I will make a covenant of peace with them; it shall be an everlasting covenant with them. And I will set My sanctuary in their midst forever,
verses.37:27: and My dwelling shall be among them; and I will be to them God, and they shall be My people.
verses.37:28: And the nations shall know that I am the Lord who sanctifies them, when My sanctuary is in their midst forever.'"
verses.38:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.38:2: "Son of man, set your face against Gog and the land of Magog, the prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal, and prophesy against him,
verses.38:3: and say to him, 'Thus says the Lord, the Lord:
verses.38:4: Behold, I am against the prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal, and I will gather you and all your host, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed in breastplates, with a great company—shields and helmets and swords:
verses.38:5: Persians and Ethiopians and Libyans, all of them with helmets and shields,
verses.38:6: Gomer and all those around him, the house of Togarmah from the uttermost north and all those around him, and many nations with you.
verses.38:7: Be prepared, prepare yourself, you and all your company who are gathered with you, and you shall be a guard for Me.
verses.38:8: After many days he shall be prepared, and at the end of years he shall come and enter into the land brought back from the sword, of those gathered from many nations, against the land of Israel, which had become wholly desolate; and he has come forth from the nations, and they shall all dwell in peace.
verses.38:9: And you shall ascend like rain, and he shall come like a cloud to cover the land, and you shall be there, you and all those around you, and many nations with you.
verses.38:10: Thus says the Lord, the Lord: And it shall come to pass in that day that matters shall arise in your heart, and you shall devise evil thoughts,
verses.38:11: and you shall say, "I will go up against a cast-off land; I will come upon those who rest in quietness and dwell in peace, all of them inhabiting a land in which there is neither wall nor bars, and they have no gates,
verses.38:12: to take plunder and to seize their spoil, to turn my hand back against the desolate place that has been resettled, and against a nation gathered from many nations, who have acquired possessions, who dwell upon the navel of the earth."
verses.38:13: Sheba and Dedan, and the Carthaginian merchants and all their villages, shall say to you, "Have you come for plunder, to take plunder and to seize spoil? Have you gathered your company to take silver and gold, to carry away possessions, to seize spoil?"'
